tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shar mdo khams kyi paṇḍi ta kun mkhyen smra ba'i seng ge go ram chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gnyis lhan cig tu bkod pa nor bu'i phreng mdzes blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsa dāai ya shrī mañdzu badzra ye/ phyag 'tshal lo bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ dpal ldan zab gsal gnyis med dkyil 'khor gser zangs ltar 'bar sku gsum zhal gyis mdzes/ /rtsa zhal gur gum bzang 'dra gzhan dag dbang sngon mdog mtshungs ku mud phreng ltar dkar/ /phyin drug phyag gi yal ga ral gri utpal mda' gzhus legs sbrel gzhan dag gis/ /rang snang 'od kyi yum la legs 'khyud bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan chos dbyings phyag rgyas brtan g.yo kun 'khyud cing / /grangs med rigs sprul thugs rje sgyu ma'i drwa ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum khengs shes rab 'bar ba'i 'od mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir mngon dkyil lhan cig bkod/ /bcom ldan gang gi sgrub thabs kun tu bzang / /rnam gsum ye shes zhabs kyi mdzad pa las/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rnam gnyis byon pa yi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin gsal bar bshad pa dang / /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rgyud rgyal las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga grub bzang gzhung bzhin du/ /gzhan la phan phyir cha lag dang bcas pa/ /sdebs legs spel la chos bdag snang ba stsol/ /dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig bsrung / /de nyid bcu ldan slob dpon gyi/ /rang gzhan smin par byed pa yi/ /cho ga bgyid la don lnga ste/ /bsnyen pa sa chog sta gon dang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga rjes 'jug ste/ /spyi sdom lnga las dang po gnyis/ /ye shes rnam rol ji bzhin no/ /sta gon gyi ni bya ba la/ /gnas bzang rgyan dgram byi dor dang / /chag chag btab la dkyil 'khor ni/ /rta babs dpangs su sgo tshad gcig

/phyi rol rdo rwa 'od zer 'phreng / /bskor ba spyi dang mthun par btab/ /nang du lha snam cha chen gcig /bzhag nas dbus kyi cha chen drug /'od zer 'phreng bas zlum por bskor/ /tshangs thig g.yas g.yon dag tu ni/ /cha phran gsum gsum dor byas la/ /bzhi pa la thig tal por btab/ /le dgur 'byung ba'i dbus su ni/ /dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang / /de yi phyogs mtshams phyi rol gyi/ /mtshams bzhi shar sgo'i g.yas dang g.yon/ /sgo bzhi rnams su dri'i thig le/ /zlum steng tshom bu bcu dgu bkod/ /de mthar byang shar mtshams 'dzin dang / /shar du bsang gtor mchod yon gnyis/ /shar lhor zhabs bsil lhor me tog /lho nub bdug spos nub mar me/ /nub byang dri mchog byang zhal zas/ /de nang bdug spos mar me dang / /zhal zas gsum tshan re re yang / /shar nub gnyis su tshan pa drug /lho byang gnyis su tshan bzhi ste/ kun dril nyi shu zlum por bshams/ /ras bris ltar na gru bzhi'o/ / paṇa chen gyi tshigs bcad las mchod gshom tsam las ma gsungs kyang 'di la lha sngags dgu'i tshom bu maṇḍal la bkod pa mañdzi'i khar bzhag pa'i 'og tu sa lha'i tshogs bu/ byang shar du ni sa lha yi/ /tshom gtor bdug spos mar me zas/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor nye drung du/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten pa'i/ /gtor ma rang rang phyag len ltar/ /mchod dang bcas re bsham bya zhing / /rdor dril nang mchod me tog snod/ /bum pa gnyis dang rdor gzungs dung / /gos zung rol mo la sogs pa/ /nyer mkho ma lus bsham bya zhing / /slob ma la dgos mtshams sbyor ni/ /logs su 'chad par bdag spro'o/ /zhes sbyor ba'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'du byas nas/ ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ las kyi rdo rjes sngon 'gro gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/

zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wā atma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod par gyur pa'i nang du gtor rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa dang / oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas gtor mgron spyan drangs/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis chu gsum dang / so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi te/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nyer spyod dang / oṃ āḥrū pa badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshapta badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgandhe badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥparṣe badzri hūm̐/ 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi phyag rgya dang / de nas pad kor bcas la/ oṃ āḥsarba trai dhwa dza/ da sha dika lo ka dhā tu/ a nanta/ ga ga na/ sa mu tra/ me gha/ bhyu ha pra sa ra/ pa ra mā nu dzo/ maṇḍal pa ram pa ra/ antargag ta sa mā patti/ ā pasd+yi tā/ dharma dha tu sa ma ba sa rā ṇa/ ā kā sha dhā tu parya ba sā na/ sarba trai dhwa dza/ da sha dika lo ka dhā tu/ a nanta/ me gha bhyu ha/ pa sa rā/ ga ga na sa mā/ sarba lo ka pā la sarba satt+wañtsa/ tadya thā/ badzra a yu dha/ mā ya badzra/ badzra a na la/ badzra kā la/ badzra mu ṣa la/ nā ga badzra/ badzra a ni la/ badzra shaṣḍo/ badzra bhai rā wa/ badzra kro dha/ badzra kuṇḍa li/ badzra pra bha/ mo na badzra/ be ma tsi tri/ pri thi wi de wa tā/ sa pa ri wa ra/ 'di nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ e maṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ dī pa/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ ā dī saṃ spuktaṃ ba liṃ u pa hā ri/ pra tītstsha/ u pa bhu dzaḥ ma ma dhi ra ṇya su warṇa dha na dha n+ya/

ā yur/ yau ba na/ ā rokṣa/ sad su khaṃ/ a sa ha ra ka sarba bighnan bi na ya kān/ sarba duṣṭan/ pra duṣṭan/ ma nu ṣya na/ a ma nu ṣya na/ dzambha ya ta/ stambha ya ta/ bandha ya ta/ bi dhāṃ sa ya ta/ ma ma dhi ra ṇyu su warna dha na dha n+ya/ ā yur yau ba na/ ā rokṣa/ sad su kha ni/ ma hā su kha pra trirdha ye/ ya pad ā bo dhi maṇḍa paryan taṃ/ ddho ka ya ta sa ta/ sa ha ya taṃ/ shanti rokṣa tsa ku ru hūm̐/ lan gsum/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / dril bu tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su dkrol la/ gtor mgron thams cad kyang rigs lnga'i ngo bor mos te/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mi phyed rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje snying khar bzung dril bu chig rdung du dkrol te/ oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyis/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyil 'khor ni/ /phan tshun gcig gi nang du gcig son pa/ /snyoms par 'jug la kun tu gnas pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing / /nam mkha'i khams kyis yongs su mthar thug pa'i/

/dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong / /kun dang sems can kun yang 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang / /rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni/ /rdo rje gtun shing rdo rje glu dag dang / /rdo rje rlung dang rdo rje sna ring dang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo dang / /rdo rje 'khyil pa rdo rje 'od dang ni/ /mi smra rdo rje dang ni thags bzang ris/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /me tog dag dang bdug pa mar me dang / /dri dang lha bshos la sogs yang dag ldan/ /nye bar spyod pa dang ni gtor ma 'di/ /so sor bzhes shing nye bar longs spyad nas/ /bdag gi dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams/ /'phrog par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren kun/ /sdang dang rab tu sdang ba thams cad dang / /mi dang mi ma yin rnams rmugs par mdzod/ /rengs dang bcings dang rnam par 'jig par mdzod/ /bdag la dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa dang / /bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel ba rnams/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ /gnang bar mdzod cig rtag tu stong grogs dang / /zhi ba dang ni bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /hūm̐/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ slob ma yod na 'di dang 'og gi sa lha phyi rol gtor ma rnams la slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba zhes bya/

phyogs skyong ba chen po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ zhes pa dang / lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la reg rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis phyir 'breng bskrad par bsam la/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sarba duṣṭaṃ gatstsha/ zhes dang / rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol/ oṃ āḥbighnan sogs brjod cing / gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor/ yang las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal la/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang bar zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob rnams kyi rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / bighnan gyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me 'od dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan zhing rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ steng thog rim par phub cing / rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i nang gi mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsangs gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig sngon 'gro gtor ma'i 'dod gsol dang gnas yo byin rlabs gnyis zin bris rnam pa sna tshogs shig gsungs kyang /

'dir ni chu gsum sogs khyad chos rnams ma gtogs 'phags lugs kyi dkyil chog rnams nas 'byung ba bzhin bris pa lags/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ gi bar so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthar/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum dang rol chen bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs gzhan rnams la dharmā ra ṇi dang rol chen mi dgos so/ /zhu 'bul byed par spro zhing 'os na/ kyai rdor sogs rgyud sde spyi 'gre ltar bya'o/ /de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la don gsum ste/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i ting nge 'dzin/ las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin/ dang po la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor/ dngos gzhi rten dang brten pa'i rnal 'byor/ rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gsum ste/ bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan don du 'gyur ba'i phyir du tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa/ lha bskyed pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag pa/ bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i dbu la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa dang / de'i rgyab 'od dpag med kyi mdun du chos po ti brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i mdun du rang dang pha ma rigs drug gi sems can rnams 'khod nas 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ lan nyer gcig thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod pas gtso 'khor rnams las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs sangs rgyas su gyur nas so so'i zhing du gshegs/ skyabs yul 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la skad cig gi rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ yab kyi sku gang /

dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa tāe no pa tiṣṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ma me muñtsa badzri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥ nyer gnyis tsam bzlas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrub shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / nyes pa dang / ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ de nas tshad med kyi rnal 'byor dngos ni/ rang skad cig gis dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar āḥdakar po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maṃ gyi yi ge gur kum gyi mdog lta bu sems gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i ngo bo/ de las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad snang bar byas nas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig

/ces brjod/ gnyis pa tshogs gnyis gsog pa ni/ slar yang snying kha'i maṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu la bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs nas/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ shrī gu hya sa mā dzaḥ maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i sgrub thabs nas mchod pa 'di la mtshan sngags spyi ming tsam las ma gsungs kyang 'di rang gi khyad chos shrī gu hya sogs sbyar ba ni 'phags lugs ltar bris pa lags/ zhes pas me tog dang de bzhin du gzhan 'dra ba la puṣpe'i gnas su/ dhū pe bcug pa nas shapta'i bar gyi nyer spyod rol mo dang / oṃ āḥrū pa badzri hūm̐/ sogs rdo rje ma lnga'i mchod la thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo las sprul pa'i rang lus 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpag tu med pa tshogs zhing rnams kyi spyan sngar pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis 'khod par bsam la/ dpal ldan bde rdzogs zab gsal gnyis med 'od zer ldan/ /de yi rang bzhin zhi ba bcu drug phyed cha 'bar/ /don dam snying po de ston bla ma gsum po rab/ /de la bya byed gsum mnyam pa yi rtag tu 'dud/ /dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dri med gzi brjid ldan/ /dpag med rigs kyi sprul pa rnams kyis rab brgyan zhing / /shes rab yan lag 'dus pa 'bar zhing rnam mdzes pa/ /'jam dpal gang de mchod phyir de la phyag 'tshal lo/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta pra ṇa me na badzra bandha naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag bya/ gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan de dag spyan sngar ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / /'phags pa gzhan gyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rangs shing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras sgrubs/ /snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas pa gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing / /sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag par skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing / /rnying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu'i dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ /yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ 'di rang la bstim pa dang gshegs gsol bya ba gnyis gsal kha mi snang yang / las dang po pa rnams kyis rtogs sla ba'i phyir du 'dus pa spyi 'gre ltar bris pa lags/ tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa'o/ ༈ /'di'ang bsam bya las rdzogs rim mi snang na'ang 'dir ni phyag len bzhin bkod pa lags/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu 'bras ngo bo gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du gyur/

zhes brjod cing don dran par byas la brtan pa'i ched du/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkhar lus ngag yid gsum thams cad kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po/ ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa/ de'i 'og tu oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su phyogs bcur padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de yang steng gi ser po/ lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus dang 'og tu rdo rje/ steng du 'khor lo/ shar du rdo rje kun mkhyen chen pos sgrub thabs las phyogs mtshams brgyad du gsungs nas sdom gnang yang 'dir so sor bral ba ni sgom bde ba'i phyir bkod pa lags tho ba/ lhor rdo rje dbyug pa/ nub tu padma dmar po/ byang du rdo rje rtse lnga/ shar lhor ral gri/ lho nub tu lcags kyu/ nub byang du dbyug pa sngon po/ byang shar du rtse gsum pa rnams hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer kha dog nag po spros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen po thob ste/ khro bo bcu 'dir yang zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i gzugs kyi gsungs pa las gzhan med kyang khro bo bcu gcig gi zhes pa ni rnam pa gsal ba'i phyir yin lags gcig gi skur gyur nas rang rang gi phyag mtshan la zhugs te yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/

g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ 'og tu rdo rje gnod mdzes sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi sogs hūm̐ mdzad bzhin/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po/ ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'dra/ shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon 'dra/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dkar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'dra/ nub tu padma mthar byed dmar po/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa kha gyes pa dang ral gri/ 'di nas bzung khro bo 'og ma rnams kyi g.yon thams cad hūm̐ mdzad bzhin/ shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma sogs/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma sogs/ nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gis dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma sogs/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'od kyis rig ma la 'khyud pa/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ khro bo bcu gcig po thams cad g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa bzhi rgod cing khros pa'i zhal dang ljags bsgyur ba/ nyi ma'i 'od dang spyan zlum po g.yo ba/ khro gnyer gyi zhal can/ che zhing 'phrang la sdug pa/ brang dang gsus pa 'phyang ba/ thung zhing sbom pa/ 'bar ba'i skra kham pa gyen du 'bar ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bsnams pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lha rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' re re/ de rnams kyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ re re/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor zhing 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa kha gyes pa'i tshogs kyis lus dang ngag dang yid la gnas pa'i bdud phyung nas phyi rol du ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang / de'i nang du logs rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / steng du rdo rje'i gur dang / 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi sdug cing 'khregs pa bar mtshams med pa'i rang bzhin gyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ sngon 'gro'i ting nge 'dzin no/ ༈ /dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gnyis te/ rten bskyed pa dang brten pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dbus kyi hūm̐ mdzad zhu ba las byung ba'i hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ nor bu dang rin po ches dbu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan mnga' ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

de yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas kha dog dkar po zur gsum pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i dbus su/ paṃ ser po las byung ba'i sna tshogs padma'i lte bar khaṃ ljang khu las sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du bhrūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba la bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer spros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i gzugs su gyur te bhrūṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan mdzes pa dang / rin po che'i rgyan can/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan mnga' ba/ rnam pa sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa rin po che'i rtsig pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyi steng na gser gyi ske rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang rnga g.yab dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / me long dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bya 'dab la thur du 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i mda' yab dang / steng du rin po che'i drwa mig gseng ma'i pu shus bskor ba/ de dag gi bar snang rnams su rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga g.yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ zur rtse bzhir gdugs bzhis mdzes shing /

phyi 'gram 'dod yon gyi snam bu la bzung ma sna tshogs pas mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi mtshams dang zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / de'i steng du gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon du rwi dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i nang du lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su dkyil 'khor nang ma'i phyi nas 'od zer lnga'i bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyis btegs pa'i steng rdo rjes gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i phyi'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i khang bzang dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ phyi bltas nang gsal/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i gnas su rab tu rgyas pa'i padma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gdan/ zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni rten bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis te/ yan lag dang 'bras bu bzhi chung ngus rje btsun yab dang / de dag 'bring gis yum bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang / rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ nam mkha'i ye shes gsum gzhal yas khang gi dbus su babs te/ rang nyid yi ge gsum gyi gzugs su gnas pa'i ye shes kyis bskul bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzhal yas khang gi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la gzigs par mdzod cig

zhes bskul bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yi ge gsum gyi gzugs kyis rang gi lus la zhugs/ de'i 'og gi char sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥphrag gnyis brjod la g.yas bskor g.yon bskor du bsam ste/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shes rab kyi ngo bo nyid yi ge gsum gyi steng gi char/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ ya ra la ba ḍa dha/ phrag gnyis brjod pa g.yas bskor g.yon bskor du dmigs te/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa thabs kyi ngo bo nyid/ gnyis ka'ang me long lta bu'i ye shes/ zla ba gnyis ka gcig tu gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las hūm̐ dmar po las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ badzra atma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod la nga rgyal bzung / hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas 'od zer gyis bkug ste hūm̐ la thim pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ ya thā sarba ta thā ga ta sta thā a haṃ/ zhes brjod/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gzugs kyi sa bon gyi yi ge hūm̐ la thim/ sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis chos kyi dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ nor bu dang rin po ches dbu brgyan pa/

zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong gi kun bzang bzhin brjod/ 'dod chags chen pos 'dul ba'i sems can rnams bde ba chen po'i thabs kyis 'dul ba'i phyir du yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsgrags pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te rje btsun yab dgyes par gyur nas lha mo mnyes par gyur/ de rnams spyan ma dang / mā ma ki dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / gzugs rdo rje dang / sgra rdo rje dang / dri rdo rje dang / ro rdo rje dang / reg rdo rje'i ngo bor byung ste rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros/ rje btsun ma'i ba spu'i bu gar zhugs pas yum dgyes par gyur pas rje btsun yab mnyes par gyur/ yab yum gnyis ka'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i padmar babs pa skad cig gis rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad bkug dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugs te bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste sems can gyi tshogs de rnams la dbang bskur bas de rnams kyi dbang po drug yul drug 'byung ba bzhi/ phung po lnga rnams zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur/ de las kṣiṃ/ dzriṃ/ khaṃ gaṃ ṣkaṃ/ saṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

khaṃ/ raṃ/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ bhrūṃ/ aṃ/ dzriṃ/ khaṃ/ hūm̐/ rnams kyi sa bon dang phyag mtshan las byung ba'i sa'i snying po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' drug gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo drug spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma bzhi/ rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga ste lha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa bha ga nas mtha' yas par spros te/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyag btsal nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni bdag cag rnams kyi ma'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni bdag cag rnams kyi pha'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa'o/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'jug pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang / /rab tu mi rtog rnyog med pa'o/ /zhes ched du brjod pas ched du brjod de bsam gyis mi khyab par spros nas phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas nam mkha' nas ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i yi ge gsum yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i me'i 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mos padmar babs pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum gnyis ka 'od du zhu ste byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur/ de nas thig le las 'phros pa'i lha mo bzhi rang rang gi gnas su 'dug nas glus bskul te/ lho nub nas mā ma kis/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ /dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /shar lho nas spyan mas/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ /sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rab tu phan bzhed ston/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/

/'dod chags dam tshig chags pa bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /nub byang nas gos dkar mos/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ /'jig rten dag ni don dang dgos pa mdzad pa rab tu brtson/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /dga' ba spyod pa kun tu bzang po bdag la dges par mdzad du gsol/ /byang shar nas sgrol mas/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan yon che/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam nyid thugs brtse ba/ /mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchi bzhed na/ /yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bskul bas thig le de maṃ las gser gyi yu ba can gyi ral gri ljang khu yu ba la maṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros te de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bde ba chen po thob par gyur te/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i gzugs kyi maṃ gyi yi ge la thim/ ral gri maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo gur gum gyi mdog lta bu/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri ljang khu dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyi utpal sngon po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang nor bu'i dbu rgyan can/ sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes bya bas chos kyi dbyings su byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa nyer sgrub dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/

mig gnyis kyi dbus su kṣiṃ las 'khor lo kṣiṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ rna bar dzriṃ las rdo rje dzriṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag rdor nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po 'dra/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ snar khaṃ las rin po che khaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nam snying ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ lcer gaṃ las padma gaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams su ṣkaṃ las ral gri ṣkaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrib sel ljang khu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ lte bar saṃ la rdo rje saṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ kun bzang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ gsum pa bsgrub pa dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/

thugs rdo rje nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sku rdo rje dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ 'di la'ang bsam zhes bya ba las brjod dgos rigs mi snang na'ang / 'dir brjod pa ni dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir lags/ de thams cad kyang rin po che dang nor bu'i dbu brgyan can zhes pa nas/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gtso bo bzhin brjod/ thugs rdo rje ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon yi ge hūm̐ las spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma byung ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bstod nas/ rig ma rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus la zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje rang gi thugs rdo rje la zhugs par bsam la/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/

/rdo rje'i thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje bdag nyid kyi thugs rdo rje la thim/ gsung rdo rje'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i sa bon gyi yi ge āḥlas spyan ma la sogs pa'i rig ma phyung ste/ zhes pa nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje bdag gi gsung rdo rje la zhugs par bsam/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje bdag nyid kyi gsung rdo rje la thim/ sku rdo rjes ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i sa bon yi ge oṃ las/ zhes pa nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum sgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje rang gi sku rdo rje la zhugs par bsam/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje bdag nyid kyi sku rdo rje la thim/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa chen po dang bral ba'i 'bras bu chung ngu ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du maṃ las ral gri maṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs nas maṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' maṃ yig gur kum gyi mdog lta bu de las 'od zer spros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo la gnas pa'i rig ma bum pa bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i chus dbang bskur/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ni sarba artha sa dha ni swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ ka ri shāntiṃ ka ri ghu ṭa ghu ṭa ghu ṭi ni gha ṭa ya ghu ṭi ni swā hā/ oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe ni ka ṭe ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe ka ro ṭa birya ye swā hā/ oṃ tā re tutta re tu re swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha mo rnams spyi bor thim pas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ sku rdo rje dang sa snying la rnam snang / thugs rdo rje dang ye shes sems dpa' dang / phyag na rdo rje dang kun tu bzang po la mi bskyod pa/ nam mkha'i snying po la rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas/ sgrib pa rnam sel la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ gnyis pa yan lag dang 'bras bu 'bring bzhis rje btsun yab yum bskyed pa la yang bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu 'bring ni/ rang gi mdun du a las zla ba'i 'dir rang 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba las g.yo ba med bzhin du sems kyi cho 'phrul yi ge gsum gyi gzugs su bsam dgos snyam ste/ gal te rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal las 'phos te yig 'brur bsam nas yum gyi sku bskyed na dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi snyoms 'jug sogs don med du thal ba'i phyir ro/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid yi ge gsum gyi gzugs su gnas pa'i ye shes kyis bskul bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzhal yas khang gi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/

zhes pa nas/ mngon byang lnga las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum bskyed de/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ de nas 'gro ba dbang bskur dor te/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas nam mkha' nas ho dmar po gnyis kyi bar du chud pa'i/ zhes sogs dang sbrel nas glus bskul ba'i bar gong bzhin las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ ral gri maṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sogs gong bzhin dang / phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma sogs nas ko3haṃ gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ gnyis pa nyer sgrub dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 'bring ni/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gsum pa bsgrub pa dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu 'bring ni/ nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ bzhi pa sgrub chen dang dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu 'bring ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i steng du maṃ las ral gri sogs dang sbrel te/ sgrib pa rnam sel la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin no// ༈ /gsum pa rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ yum gyi spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ yig dkar po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo mgrin pa yan chad du khyab pa/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ yig nag po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo nu ma'i bar du khyab pa/ lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la swa yig ser po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo sum mdo'i bar du khyab pa/ padma'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la a yig dmar po rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo brla la thug par khyab pa/ byin pa gnyis su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ha yig ljang khu rdul phra rab kyi ngo bo rkang pa'i bar du khyab pa/

zhes brjod de yum rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can du bsam ste/ de'i pang na gnas pa'i rang 'od kyi thabs dang rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba dbyer med/ rang gi pang na gnas pa'i rang 'od kyi rig ma dang bskyed ma thag pa'i yum dbyer med du bsgom dgos pa kho bo'i rnam rtog la shar la/ gzhan kun mkhyen chen po'i sgrub thabs na dmigs bsal gang yang ma gsungs pas las dang po pa rnams kyi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum zhu ba glus bskul bas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar bzhengs pa'i nga rgyal nyid sgom na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo go 'phos pa'i skyon 'byung ngam snyam pas dpyod ldan rnams kyis dgongs 'tshal lo/ /de ni 'phros don no/ /de nas/ yab kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu'i bug par phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi padma hūm̐ las padma dmar po a las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru'i bug par phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas yab yum snyoms par zhugs par bsam mo/ /sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// ༈ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la bzhi las/ dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu chen po ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la reg ste bde ba chen po thob nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhal du zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur nas rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas padmar lhung ba yongs su gyur pa las sa bon maṃ gyi yi ger gyur/ de las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gcig car du gyur/ badzra dhṛka mkha' nang gi mi bskyod pa phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas/ zhe sdang gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus zhe sdang chen po bskyed pa'i rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang /

shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin rang gi lus la thim/ dzi na dzika mkha' nang gi rnam par snang mdzad phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas gti mug gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas gti mug chen po bskyed par byed pa'i gzugs kyi phung po dang / me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ shar phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ ratna dhṛka mkha' nang gi rin 'byung phyir spros nas dpag tu med par gyur nas/ nga rgyal gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas nga rgyal chen po bskyed par byed pa'i tshor ba'i phung po dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin lho phyogs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ a ro lika mkha' nang gi snang ba mtha' yas phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas/ 'dod chags gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas 'dod chags chen po bskyed par byed pa'i 'du shes kyi phung po dang / so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ nub phyogs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ 'od dpag med dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ pra dzñā dhṛka mkha' nang gi don grub phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas/

phrag dog gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas phrag dog chen po bskyed par byed pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po dang / bya ba nan tan gyi rang bzhin byang phyogs su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ don grub ljang khu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /mo ha ra ti/ mkha' nang gi spyan ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad kyi zhi ba'i las mdzad/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas ring du song bas sa rnam par dag pa sa'i khams dang / snying rje chen po dang / stong pa nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin me'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ spyan ma dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ dwe ṣa ra ti/ mkha' nang gi mā ma ki phyir spros te/ dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad kyi bsrung ba'i las mdzad de/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas mi g.yo ba'i sa rnam par dag pa chu'i khams dang / byams pa chen po dang / mtshan ma med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / smon lam gyi pha rol du phyin pa'i steng na srin po'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni mā ma ki sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/

rā ga ra ti/ mkha' nang gi gos dkar mo phyir spros te/ dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad rgyas par byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus pa legs pa'i blo gros rnam par dag pa me'i khams dang dga' ba chen po dang / smon pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin rlung gi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ badzra ra ti/ mkha' nang gi sgrol ma phyir spros te/ dpag tu med par gyur nas sems can thams cad dbang du byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas chos kyi sprin gyi sa rnam par dag pa rlung gi khams dang / btang snyoms chen po dang / mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang / ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin dbang ldan ni mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ sgrol ma ser mo ser sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi gzugs rdo rje ma phyir spros te/ dpag tu med par gyur nas ser sna gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba rnam par dag pa ser sna'i gnyen po/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin phyi rol gyi me'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis me long dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi sgra rdo rje ma phyir spros te/ dpag tu med par gyur nas/ 'chal pa'i tshul khrims gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas dri ma med pa'i sa rnam par dag pa/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi gnyen po/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin srin po'i mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis pi waṃ dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ 'di nas bzung lha mo 'og ma thams cad kyang g.yon 'dra/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi dri rdo rje ma dpag tu med par gyur nas khro bo gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas 'od byed pa'i sa rnam par dag pa khro ba'i gnyen po/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin/ rlung gi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ dri rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dri'i dung dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma sogs oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi ro rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas/ le lo gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas 'od 'phros pa'i sa rnam par dag pa le lo'i gnyen po/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin dbang ldan gyi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni ro rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi reg rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas g.yeng ba gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/

slar gcig tu 'dus nas sbyang dka' ba'i sa rnam par dag pa g.yeng ba'i gnyen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin shar sgo'i byang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ reg rdo rje ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis thabs sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis sna tshogs pa'i gos dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkha' nang gi chos dbyings rdo rje ma phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas shes rab 'chal pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas mngon du gyur pa'i sa rnam par dag pa shes rab 'chal ba'i gnyen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin shar sgo'i lho phyogs su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa ni/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis chos 'byung dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ lha mo bcu po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ rin po che dang nor bu'i dbu rgyan can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang na bza' sna tshogs gsol ba/ zla ba'i gdan dang zla ba'i 'od yod pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ āḥya manta kṛta hūm̐/ mkha' nang gi gshin rje'i gshed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas ma dad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas/ ma dad pa dang phung po'i bdud dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba rnams kyi gnyen po/ dad pa gtso bor gyur pa/ shar sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/

g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥpra dzñanta kṛta hūm̐/ mkha' nang gi shes rab mthar byed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas le lo gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas le lo dang / nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / log par lta ba rnams kyi gnyen po/ brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa lho sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥpadmanta kṛta hūm̐/ mkha' nang gi padma mthar byed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas brjed ngas gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas brjed ngas pa dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud dang / skye ba'i sgrib pa dang mthar 'dzin par lta ba rnams kyi gnyen po/ dran pa gtso bor gyur pa nub sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ padma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyis rig ma sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma rgyas pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta hūm̐/ mkha' nang gi bgegs mthar byed phyir spros te dpag tu med par gyur nas rnam g.yeng gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar gcig tu 'dus nas rnam par g.yeng ba dang / lha'i bdud dang / las kyi sgrib pa dang / tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin pa rnams kyi gnyen po/ ting nge 'dzin gtso bor gyur pa byang sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa ni/ bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje kha gyes pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa zhes pa nas/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bsrung 'khor gyi skabs bzhin brjod/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros gshin rje gshed la reg pas des dzaḥzhes brjod pas gshin rje gshed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ āḥya manta kṛta dzaḥ zhes dang / lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa'i g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel ba lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ 'di dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag rgya rnams kyis thim cing mnyes par bya ba rnams/ lha sta gon dang bum bskyed bdag 'jug sogs gzhan dgos rig rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /de nas/ rang gi g.yon du shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor gsum gyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ lan gcig gis gsang gtor dang / oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta hūm̐ swāhā/ lan gnyis kyis mchod yon dang zhabs bsil byin gyis brlab la/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas ye shes pa la gsang gtor mchod yon zhabs bsil dang / oṃ āḥrū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros khro bo gzhan gsum la reg pas de dag gis hūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams brjod do/ /de dag so so'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams dam tshig pa la bstim pa dang /

bcings pa dang mnyes par byas/ zhes brjod la/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi mkhrig ma'i steng g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mkhrig ma'i rgyab sbyar ba zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥpra dzñānta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes pas ye shes pa dam tshig pa la bstim khu tshur gnyis gan rkyal gyi mthe chung gnyis dang / mdzub mo gnyis so sor sbrel ba lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥpadmanta kṛta baṃ/ zhes pas dam tshig dbyer med du bcings/ g.yon pas khu tshur g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du brtsegs nas bskyod pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥbighnan kṛta hoḥzhes brjod pas mnyes par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa nye sgrub dang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chen po ni/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gsum pa sgrub pa dang skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu chen po ni/ nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo yab yum dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha rnams kyi skye mched thugs gsung sku byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshig rigs rnams bsdu bar 'dod na lha sta gon bzhin brjod kyang mi 'gal bar bzhed/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ bzhi pa sgrub chen dang dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu chen po ni/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ chu gsum dang / rū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la thal mo sbyar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo la gnas pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las lha mo rnams spyi bor thim pas zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/

gtso bo dang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ spyan ma dang gzugs rdo rje dang / gshin rje'i gshed la rnam par snang mdzad/ ma mā ki dang sgra rdo rje dang / chos dbyings rdo rje dang / shes rab mthar byed dang / bgegs mthar byed la mi bskyod pa/ gos dkar mo dang / ro rdo rje dang / rta mgrin la 'od dpag med/ reg rdo rje la don grub sgrol ma dang dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbu brgyan/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste zhal nas zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa/ rdo rje nor bu'i laṃ nas lha mo'i padmar lhung ste/ zla ba'i gdan bcu la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ rnams su gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bcur gyur pa ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros te/ bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu hya sogs lan gcig 'gor sbyar ba'i/ puṣpe nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang / rū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ mchod bya mchod byed gnyis su med par bsam ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra sogs tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar brjod/ bstod bya bstod byed gnyis su med par bsam ste thal mo sbyar la/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod/ rdo rje gsor te mdun gyi nang mchod/ bighnanta kṛs bsangs/ shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan dang bcas shing yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/

shar du dri chen la bhrūṃ/ lhor rakta la aṃ/ nub tu byang sems dkar po la dzriṃ/ byang du sha chen gyi dwangs ma khaṃ/ dbus su dri chu la hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ sa bon de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug nas rang rang gi sa bon la bcug ste/ de'i rkyen gyis 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ 'bar ba dang / gsal ba dang / dros pa dang / lhag par gyur/ de'i rlangs pa la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lan gsum spros te zhugs/ de'i steng du oṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi thams cad bkug ste yi ge oṃ la thim/ oṃ yig kyang zhu nas bdud rtsi la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi dbus nas blangs te/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyung ste bdud rtsi gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥmaṃ bhrūṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes brjod la rang gi lce thog tu myangs pas/ snying kha'i sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor tshim par bsam mo/ sta gon gyi skabs 'dir cung zad mnyam par bzhag la de nas bzlas pa la 'jug go /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog la gsum las dang po thig le'i rnal 'byor ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ des sems can thams cad sangs rgyas su byas nas tshur 'dus sa bon maṃ yig la thim/ maṃ gyi yi ge thig ler gyur pa'i nang du sems bzung ste tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin gsum skad cig mas bsgom ste/ de'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer phyung bas ral gri'i yu ba dang /

ye shes sems dpa'i lus dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / gzhal yas khang dang / dam tshig sems dpa'i lus dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang / gzhal yas khang rnams gsal bar byas nas phyi rol du song ste/ 'gro ba thams cad gsal bar byas nas slar log ste/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kha'i sa bon maṃ yig la thim ste/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu yang yang bya'o/ /gnyis pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhal du zhugs/ zla ba zhu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa padma'i nang du lhung ba las/ ral gri nas tsam gyi yu ba'i dbus su hūm̐ gi sa bon las mngon byang lnga'i rim pas gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i rje btsun rdo rje sems dpar gyur te/ gnyis ka mnyes pa la sogs pas cho gas thig le'i rnal 'byor la thug gi bar skad cig gis sgrub nas/ de'i thugs ka nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa spros pas ye shes sems dpa' gsal ba sogs sngar bzhin spro bsdu bya'o/ /gsum pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i dbus su sku rdo rje de'i thugs khar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su gsung rdo rje/ de'i thugs khar padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la āḥ ral gri'i yu ba'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i thugs khar ral gri'i yu ba'i dbus su yi ge maṃ/ snying khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus su thugs rdo rje/ de'i thugs khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ rnams gsal nas/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ brgya rtsa/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūm̐/ oṃ āḥratna dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ a ro lika hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dzñā dhṛka hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti hūm̐/

oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ra ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshapta badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgandha badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥparṣe badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharma dha tu badzri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥya manta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dzñanta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadmanta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta hūm̐/ thams cad lan gsum re bzlas pa'i rjes su/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis byin rlabs brtan par byas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha rnams la thim/ 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la thim/ zhes brjod/ ༈ de nas sa lha'i sgos mchod spos mar me sbar/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ sa lha'i sta gon ni/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyangs te sa la reg pa'am mos pa byas la/ ngag tu/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig 'bar ba/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang / g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ tshom bu'i steng du bzhugs par bsam la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags re re mgor sbyar ba'i dhū pe nas shapta'i mthar dharmā rā ṇi rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ adya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la/ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ skyabs dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /lan gsum gyi rjes su rdo rje thugs kha dang dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhes pa nas/ 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin la/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ sa'i lha mos rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam la/ spyan 'dren bzhin lag pa g.yas brkyangs te/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi badzra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim/ zhes brjod// ༈ lha sta gon ni/ bkod zin pa'i tshom bu rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gsum brjod/ dkyil 'khor bighnan gyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa nag po kha gyes pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las byung ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer phyogs kun tu 'phros pas bgegs thams cad bsal/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi 'od zer de nyid las rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / drwa ba dpangs su dpag tshad brgya stong du yod pa/

bdud thams cad kyis bgrod par mi nus pa phyogs thams cad du khyab pa/ phyi rol na dus mtha'i me'i phung po 'bar ba lta bus bskor ba dang / rdo rje rang bzhin gyi sa'i dkyil 'khor sa 'og gi mthar thug pa/ de'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas kha dog dkar po zur gsum pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i dbus su paṃ ser po las byung ba'i sna tshogs padma'i lte bar khaṃ ljang khu las sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du/ bhrūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba la bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ zhes pa nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gdan/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo gur kum gyi mdog lta bu/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi yum 'jam dpa'i rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri ljang khu dang mda'/ sogs nas/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug sogs/ lhor rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i sogs/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i sogs/ byang du don grub ljang khu ljang sngo dkar ba'i sogs/ thams cad kyang mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs so'i bar dang / mer spyan ma dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs sogs/ srin por ma mā ki sngon mo sogs/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo sogs/ dbang ldan du sgrol ma ser mo sogs/ phyi rol gyi me'i mtshams su gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo sogs/

srin por sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo sogs/ rlung du dri rdo rje ma ser mo sogs/ dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo sogs/ shar sgo'i byang du reg rdo rje ma ljang khu sogs/ shar sgo'i lho phyogs su chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo sogs dang / lha mo bcu po thams cad kyang shin tu sgeg cing / zhes pa nas/ bzhugs so'i bar dang / shar sgor gshin rje gshed sngon po sogs/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po sogs/ nub sgor padma mthar byed dmar po sogs/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po sogs dang / khro bo bzhi po thams cad kyang g.yon bskyang bas bzhugs pa zhes pa nas/ brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o'i bar dang / ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ yig las zhes pa nas/ lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ āḥya manta kṛta dzaḥzhes pa'i bar rnams sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pa'i mthar/ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /zhes lan gsum brjod pas ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ spos rdor dril bzhag rang gi g.yon du shaṃ las byung ba'i zhes pa nas/ bighnan ta kṛta hoḥ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du mig gnyis kyi dbus su kṣiṃ las 'khor lo kṣiṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sa snying dkar po/ rna bar dzriṃ las rdo rje dzriṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las phyag rdor nag po/ rnar khaṃ las rin po che khaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las nam snying ser po/ lcer gaṃ las padma gaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ skra mtshams su ṣkaṃ las ral gri ṣkaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sgrib sel ljang khu/

lte bar saṃ las rdo rje saṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las kun bzang dkar po/ nu ma gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje nag po/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las padma as mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje dmar po/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje dkar po/ thams cad kyang zhal thams cad kyang zhes pa nas bzhugs pa'o'i bar 'di gzhung zin bris sogs gang du'ang mi snang ba dmigs pa bsal ba'i phyir kho bos kha bskang ba lags/ gsum phyag drug pa rang 'od kyi rig ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod la sgrub thabs bzhin gsal btab/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis chu gsum dang / rū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse mo la gnas pa'i zhes pa nas/ sgrol ma dang dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste zhal nas zhugs zhes pa nas/ lha mo bcur gyur zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/

thal mo khong stong dpral bar sbyar nas se gol gtogs te/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ de rnams rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros dpag tu med par gyur te dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor du 'khod nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod par gyur/ de nas mar me legs pa sbar te/ bighnan gyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes sogs gnas yo byin rlabs ltar la/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang chu gsum nas rol mo'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas sngags rnams gnas yo byin rlabs ltar brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ de nas rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar la gdangs dang bcas/ lha yi bsang gtor dam pa 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /pad kor bcas pa'i mthar mchod yon gyi phyag rgyas rjes su se gol phyir gtogs nang gtogs/ pad kor dang se gol 'di bzhin rol mo'i bar du'ang shes par byas la/ oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra dhṛka oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ de bzhin du bsang gtor gyi sngags kun gyi mjug tu sbyar la/ oṃ bhrūṃ dzi na dzika oṃ aṃ ratna dhṛka oṃ dzriṃ a ro lika oṃ khaṃ pradzña dhṛka oṃ laṃ mo ha ra ti/ oṃ maṃ dwe ṣa ra ti/ oṃ paṃ rā ga ra ti/ oṃ taṃ badzra ra ti/ oṃ dzaḥrū pa badzri/ oṃ hūm̐ shapta badzri/ oṃ baṃ gandha badzri/ oṃ hoḥr sa badzri/ oṃ khaṃ parshe badzri/ oṃ raṃ dharma dhā tu badzri/ oṃ hūm̐ ya manta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ pradzñānta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ padmanta kṛta/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnan ta kṛta oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ de bzhin du mchod yon zhabs bsil gnyis la'ang sngags phyag rgya thams cad 'di dang 'dra ba las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ lha yi mchod yon dam pa 'dis/ /zhes dang / lha yi zhabs bsil dam pa 'dis/

/zhes tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam mo/ /chu skyes de bzhin thang las skyes/ /me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra dhṛka puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang shes par byas la/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnanta kṛta puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /de bzhin bdug spos mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra dhu paṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ nas/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnan ta kṛta dhū paṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar/ zhun mar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /lha rdzas 'bar bas mun pa 'joms/ /mi shes thams cad zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ /oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra dī paṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ nas/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnan ta kṛta dī paṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yis/ /dri mchog dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra gandhaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ nas/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnan ta kṛta gandhaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ bza' dang bca' ba yang dag ldan/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan zhing / /thams cad sbyar pa'i zhal zas 'di/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra nai wi dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ nas/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnan ta kṛta nai wi dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs/ /dbyangs kyi nga ro ldan pa 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni khyod kyis bzhes/ /oṃ maṃ mañdzu badzra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ nas/ oṃ hūm̐ bighnan ta kṛta shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i mthar/ ghaṇḍa ra ni/

rol chen/ gzugs sogs thabs kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa ni/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bzhi/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu ṇa badzra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / lag pa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur byas pa'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar par/ g.yas thal mo brkyang ba'i mkhrig ma gyen du bslangs te bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya bya/ sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gtso/ /zhes dang / sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ rū pa'i gnas su shapta bcug la dril gsil rol chen/ dri la rnam gsum shes byas te/ /sangs rgyas sogs la 'bul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /zhes dang g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyen du bslangs pa dung chos 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas mtheb mdzub sbyar nas sor mo lhag ma gsum brkyang ba'i rtses dri chu 'bul tshul dang / gandhaṃ ka ma gu ṇa/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni 'bul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs so/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes dang rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya/ rā sa ka ma gu ṇa/ reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /bdag gi rigs la 'bul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o/ /zhes dang / rdo rje khu tshur gyis gos zung gi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs 'bul tshul byas la/ parṣe ka ma gu ṇa/ zhes sogs kyis mchod do/ /gnyis pa gzugs sogs shes rab kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa ni/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /'jo sgeg sgyu 'phrul rol pas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med gzugs kyi sprin gyis mchod/

/kun 'dzin rnam sbyong ma chags rab dga'i sa bsgrub shog /phyag rgya 'dra ba las/ oṃ āḥrū pa badzri hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab spras sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /yan lag mkhrig ldan dbyangs kyis mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med sgra yi sprin gyis mchod/ /'chal tshul rnam sbyong khrims dag dri med sa bsgrub shog /dril gsil rol chen/ oṃ āḥshapta badzri hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyi rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /dri zhim spos ngad ldang bas mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med dri zhim sprin gyis mchod/ /khro ba rnam sbyong bzod dag 'od byed sa sgrub shog /phyag rgya 'dra/ oṃ āḥgandhaṃ badzri hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /ro mchog brgya ldan mtha' yas bcud kyis zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med ro mchog sprin gyis mchod/ /le lo rnam sbyong brtson dag 'od 'phro'i sa sgrub shog /phyag rgya 'dra/ oṃ āḥrā sa badzri hūm̐/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /'jam zhing bde bskyed mtha' yas reg byas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med reg mchog sprin gyis mchod/ /g.yeng ba rnam sbyong rtse gcig sbyang dka'i sa sgrub shog /gos zung 'bul tshul dang / oṃ āḥparṣe badzri hūm̐/ 'di nas gos zung bsdus/ bud med mtshan gyis rab rgyas sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /spros med rgya chen chos kyis mtha' yas zhing bkang nas/ /ma lus rgyal ba dpe med chos kyi sprin gyis mchod/ /mi shes rnam sbyong shes rab mngon gyur sa sgrub shog /thal mo sbyar ba las g.yas g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub gnyis so sor sbyar ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥdharma dhā tu badzri hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ nang mchod sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi rjes su nang mchod nas mtheb srin g.yon pas blang ste gtor bas rdul phra rab dang mnyam pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas mchod par bsam la/
