ngag tu/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / rang gis gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gang la thob pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod/ rdo rje 'chang / 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ grub chen dpal bde ba/ paṇa chen dri med sbas pa/ paṇa grub rin chen rdo rje/ mkhas pa rin chen grags pa/ bla ma paṇḍi pa chen po/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags pa/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ slob dpon bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan kun dga' bsod nams/ khams ston rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyan chen grags pa blo gros/ shar khangs pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar chen ye shes bzang po/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas ye shes/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥmaṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/

oṃ āḥdzi na dzika a mṛ ta hūm̐/ nas/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas/ mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas lus dkyil tshim par bsam mo/ /bar phud gyis gtor ma sbyangs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ye/ ma hā kā li de wi ye/ dharma pā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gdong bzhi pa sogs dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ gza' chen dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/

zhes brjod/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying kha nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dpag tu med pa spros nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phul nas/ rgyal ba rnams rig ma'i 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod cing / mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bsam la/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma thugs rje'i spyan/ /bstan mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /zhi mdzad thabs mkhas ring song sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes dang / pad kor sngon 'gro'i 'khyud rgya sngags phyag rgya 'di gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par byas la/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma byams ma'i bdag /rlan mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /bsrung mdzad smon lam mi g.yo'i sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs/ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma dga' dkar mo/ /smin mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /rgyas mdzad mi rdzi legs pa'i sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma btang snyoms sgrol/ /g.yo mdzad dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /dbang mdzad ye shes chos sprin sa sgrub ma/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje༞ /mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma ye shes dbyings/ /go 'byed dbyings kyi 'dren pa rgya mtsho bskrun/ /mchog mdzad chos sku kun tu 'od sgrub pa/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs brjod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod do/ /bzlas pa'i mchod pa ni/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med par spros/ mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams la phog pas de dag gi thugs bde bas mnyes par byas/

'od zer gyi rtse mo nas mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ des phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta hūm̐ gi bar sgrub thabs kyi bzlas pa bzhin lan gsum re brjod pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod// ༈ bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa gnyis bighnan gyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du lha bcu dgu'i gnas su rab tu rgyas pa'i padma rnams kyi steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gdan/ las thams cad pa'i bum par padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang / shar du rnam snang dkar po/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs so'i bar dang / mer spyan ma dkar mo sogs dang / phyi rol gyi me'i mtshams su zhes pa dang / shar gyi byang du reg rdo rje ma sogs dang / shar gyi lho phyogs su chos dbyings rdo rje ma sogs nas/ bzhugs so'i bar dang / shar du gshin rje gshed sogs nas/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa'i bar rnams lha sta gon bzhin la dmigs bsal bkod pa rnams ma nor ba bya/ las thams cad pa'i bum par bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje kha gyes pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ khro bo lnga po thams cad kyang g.yon brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ zhes pa nas/ brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o'i bar/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu khro bo bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ āḥya manta kṛta dzaḥ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang se gol gyi sgras spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum gyi chu gsum dang / rū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ oṃ āḥpradzñanta kṛta sogs nas/ ta kṛta hoḥba'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas brjod/ slar yang ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon maṃ las zhes pa nas sgrol ma dang dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan/ zhes pa'i bar sta gon bzhin la/ bgegs mthar byed la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī gu hya sa mā dza maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra re re sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gsum nyer mchod dril gsil rol chen dang / oṃ āḥrū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod/ oṃ āḥmaṃ bhrūṃ aṃ sogs nas/ khaṃ raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ gis nang mchod mtheb srin gyis phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lngas bstod/ pad kor dang bcas pas gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ lha thams cad kyi rgyud bskul te/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ rnam rgyal la dmigs nas/ gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa/ 'khor rnams la gsum gsum/ las bum la bighnan ta kṛta nyer gcig thun mong du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐zhes pa nyer gcig bzlas nas gong bzhin chu gsum nyer mchod rol mo rdo rje ma lnga bdud rtsi rnams kyis mchod/

de nyid lnga pas bstod la thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs nas/ stsal du gsol gyis dngos grub blangs/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs shlau ka gcig gis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ pad kor dang bcas pas dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blug ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu nas byang chub sems kyi ngo bo dang ldan par gyur/ de nas so so'i ku shas chu gtor te rnam rgyal la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la dbang bskur bar mdzod cig ces dang / las bum la/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams bzlog par mdzod cig zhes brjod/ de nas sta gon gyi nyin dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bar snang gi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs gyis gang bar bsam la/ chu gsum nyer mchod rol mo rdo rje ma lnga bdud rtsi rnams kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ nub gnyis pa man chad la mchod bstod 'di mi dgos so/ /de nas pus btsugs lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsam nas/ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas gdangs dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchog /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyod rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag nyid 'bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/ /de ni gnang ba mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /gang su lha yi spyan mnga' ba'i/ /sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi bas/

/dkyil 'khor 'jam dpal 'byung ba ni/ /'gro ba dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /yo byad ci 'byor pas 'bri na/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su/ /tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig zhes gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas mdun gyi gtor ma rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / bighnan gyis bsangs/ shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ la rlung gi zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pa'i bar bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ oṃ yig kyang zhu nas gtor ma la thim/ zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam la rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas/ oṃ āḥmaṃ mañdzu badzra pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ nas/ oṃ āḥbi ghnan ta kṛta pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gsum/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐ lan gsum gyis chu gsum dang / oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i phyag rgya dang / mtheb srin gyis nang mchod phul la/ oṃ āḥmaṃ bhrūṃ aṃ sogs nas/ a mṛ ta hūm̐ gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de nyid lnga pas bstod la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye'i bar dang / rdo rje thugs kar dang dril bu chig brdung gis/ rdo rje gsum dngos mi phyed sku/ /ye shes lnga ldan bde ba che/ /'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ de nas 'bul bzhin pa yin na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sogs kyis gtor ma byin rlabs dran par byas la/

kyai rdor bde mchog nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar dkyus bzhin dang / de rjes oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor mgron spyan drang ba ni/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten skyong ba rnams bkug ste rang rang gi gzugs kyi rang rang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khod/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje phur bu bcu/ stod rang rang gi phyogs kyi srung 'khor gyi khro bo'i dbyibs su gnas pa/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bus shes rab dam pa la 'khyud pa spros pa rnams kyi thugs kha nas rang 'dra'i khro bo spros te/ g.yon pas phur bus mgul pa nas bzung / g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba spyi bo nas brdungs zhes brjod la/ lag pa g.yon khu tshur bcangs nas phur bu 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo lhag ma gsum brkyang ba mtho ba'i phyag rgyas bzung tshul byas la/ oṃ āḥya manta kṛta sarba duṣṭa ind+ran sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥprañdzānti kṛta sarba duṣṭan ya man sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥpadmanta kṛta sarba duṣṭa na ya gan sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta sarba duṣṭan ga na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kun mkhyen chen pos gtor chog gi dpe 'ga' zhig na yi ge ma dag pa yin na ma gtogs shar lhor 'dod rgyal dang / byang shar du mi g.yo ba'i sngags bris par snang mod/ 'di ni 'gal bar mngon te/ phur pa'i stod lhar bskyed pa'i skabs su stod rang rang gi phyogs kyi srung 'khor gyi khro bo'i dbyibs su gnas pa zhes gsungs pas na/ srung 'khor la shar lhor mi g.yo ba yod pa bzhin 'dir ni sngags 'bri tshul yang de bzhin lags/ oṃ āḥ.ā tsa la sarba duṣṭa agni sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ āḥṭa ki rā dza sarba duṣṭa nitti sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇḍa sarba duṣṭa wa yu na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la sarba duṣṭa ī shwa ran sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥtsakra warti sarba duṣṭa pañtsi tra arka li ta ma hā na sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥsumbha rā dza sarba duṣṭa bi ma li tsa tri pri thi wi dāe wan sa pa ri wā ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing / rkang pa'i mthar thug pa'i bar du phur bus btab pas thams cad kyang gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur pa ni/ gtor snod kyi shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ de'i g.yon phyogs su rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ shar lhor rdo rje me dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ lho nub tu rdo rje gtun shing nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ nub byang du rdo rje rlung ljang khu don grub kyi cod pan can/ de'i g.yon phyogs na rdo rje sna ring dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bo dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ steng gi phyogs kyi cha la rdo rje 'od dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje 'khyil pa nag po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ g.yon du rdo rje mi smra ser po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ 'og tu thags bzang ris sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ de'i g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser mo rnam snang gi cod pan can/ thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa sna tshogs padma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sa'i lha mo ma gtogs gzhan thams cad phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi shes rab ma dang /

sa lha rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i gos dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad nye bar 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ chu gsum 'bul ba nas bzung / zhi ba dang ni bsrung bar mdzad du gsol hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma/ bzlas pa sogs rgyun bzhin/ bskang ba byed tshe bskang rdzas byin rlabs nas bzung / gtor 'bul gyi bar so so'i phyag len bzhin/ skabs 'di'am yang na sta gon grol nas/ slob ma sta gon dgos na logs su 'chad pa'i mtshams sbyor bzhin bya'o/ /rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bighnan gyis bsangs/ shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i zhes pa nas/ mtha' klas par gyur zhes pa dang / chu gsum nas/ rol mo'i bar gyi mchod pa rnams sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar gong gi mchod phreng bzhin/ de nas mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gsum nas rol chen gyi bar dang / rdo rje ma lnga bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bar kyang khro bo'i sa bon hūm̐ bzhi/ de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa'i mchod pa'i bar rnams bum bskyed bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can sogs 'dod gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs shlau ka gcig dang / gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sems bying ba dang / rgod pa dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing / lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcing ba las/ mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad de spyi bor ldog pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang /

hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de nas bshad ma thag pa bzhin mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa nas/ 'dod gsol gyi bar bya/ rten yod pa rnams la phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs dang / rten la ma brten pa'i sogs nas/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥ.a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ a dya nutpanna twata hūm̐/ muḥ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang / rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi mig tu sa snying dkar po/ rna bar phyag rdor nag po/ snar nam snying ser po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ skra mtshams su sgrib sel ljang khu/ lte bar kun bzang dkar po/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje nag po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po/ spyi bor sku rdo rje dkar po/ 'gro ba thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no/ /dpal ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje mgon/ /rnal 'byor gyis thob dge ba gang / /bde chen ye shes rang byung nas/ /sems can kun mkhyen sar bgrod shog /gang zhig 'di mthong 'dod pa'ang / /gang zhig zhu bar 'dod pa des/ /thugs kyi dbang phyug grangs med pa/ /mgon po de 'dra mthong bar shog /nam mkha'i mtha' klas phyogs bcu ru/ /sems can kun gyi don spyod la/ /ji ltar thugs kyi dbang phyug bzhin/ /bdag gis kyang ni mthong bar shog /ji srid thog ma med pa nas/ /'khor ba yi ni mthar thug pa/ /de srid sems can phan pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa bdag spyod shog /ji srid sangs rgyas sna tshogs rnams/ /'jig rten gnyen bshes mya ngan 'das/

/de ni bstan pa'i don du ni/ /bskal pa'i bskal par spyod par shog /rdo rje 'chang sogs gzugs kyis ni/ /bdag gis phyogs bcur sprul gyur cig /sngags kyi tshul gyi sems can mchog /de tshe bdag gis 'dul gyur cig /'og nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis bya'o/ /sta gon no/ /de nas lha sta gon gyi tshom bu dang / mchod pa dman pa rnams bsal la/ ༈ thig tshon byin rlabs ni/ stegs ji ltar rigs par/ dbus su tshon sngon po la hūm̐/ shar du dkar po la bhrūṃ/ lhor ser po la aṃ/ nub tu dmar po la dzriṃ/ byang du ljang khu la khaṃ bris te phyogs bzhi'i yig 'bru rnams mgo phyir bstan/ dbus ma'i zhabs kyu rang la bstan pa'i khar/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud bkram la/ mdun du mchod pa lnga dang / zlum gtor gcig bshams/ rdo rje'i rtse'i nang mchod nas thig tshon la 'thor tshul byas la/ bighnan gyis bsangs/ shū n+ya tas sbyangs/ thig tshon mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rab tu rgyas pa'i padma lnga'i steng du/ dbus dang phyogs gzhan gsum du nyi ma/ shar du zla ba/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dkar po bhrūṃ las rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi sogs/ thig tshon ser po aṃ las rin 'byung ser po sogs/ thig tshon dmar po dzriṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po sogs/ thig tshon ljang khu khaṃ las don grub ljang khu sogs/ thams cad kyang mdzes pa'i ral pa'i zhes pa nas/ bzhugs so'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ rang gi mig gnyis su dza las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od 'bar bar gyur/ mig gi rdzi ma myur du brdabs pas/

nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha dang rnam snang la sogs pa rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te mdun gyi thig tshon gyi rigs lnga la thim/ zhes brjod la thal mo sbyar nas/ mi bskyod la sogs thugs ye shes/ /srad bu thams cad byed dang bcas/ /rang gi 'khor lor thig gdab phyir/ /mi bskyod thig ni stsal du gsol/ /rnam snang la sogs/ /srad bu thams cad byed༞ /rang gi 'khor lor༞ /brtag pa'i thig ni༞ /rin 'byung la sogs/ /srad bu thams cad byed༞ /rang gi 'khor lor༞ /rin 'byung thig ni༞ /snang mtha' la sogs/ /srad bu thams cad byed༞ /rang gi 'khor lor༞ /snang mtha'i thig ni༞ /don grub la sogs/ /srad bu thams cad byed༞ /rang gi 'khor lor༞ /don grub thig ni༞ /de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a ka ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul nas/ rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ tshon rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ badzra sa mā ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i rjes su/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis tshon gyi yig 'bru rnams phyis/ de nas/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thig skud rang gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung / g.yas pas thig sna so so slob rnam snang gi nga rgyal 'dzin pas ma la rim bzhin gtad de/ oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmaḥ spha ra spha ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmaḥbadzra añdza li ya a dha yanta a nu pra biṣṭa sarba dharmaḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang dang po so so dang / de nas gcig tu bsgril/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i lte ba la dkris te dri bzang gi chu gtor la bsrung ba bya/

de nas dpon slob gnyis kas rdor dril thig tshon la/ slob dpon nub tu gnas pas/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod cing slob ma la thig skud gtad/ des kyang / dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod cing blangs/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /khyod kyi 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul nas ni/ /de rnams 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra sa mā ya su tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis dang por steng nas 'og tu bcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byon nas thig skud la thim/ de nas sa la phab ste thig chen brgyad dang / logs thig bzhi steng du gdab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam/ de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkhar byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni/ tshangs thig dang logs thig rnams rgyab 'gros zur thig rgyab 'gros spangs pa'i g.yas skor/ slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du gnas pas tshangs thig dang po/ de nas g.yas skor gyis/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros kyis phyin la lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros kyis phyin la byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig slob dpon rlung dang slob ma srin por gnas pas nub kyi logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi logs thig slob dpon me dang slob ma srin por gnas pas lho'i logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ slob dpon srin por dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa rnams btab la/ slob dpon nub slob ma shar du gnas pas thig skud bsdu'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor phyin la/

rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra be ga kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod la ye thig nam mkhar bteg ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin la gzhi bca' pad kor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu dkur bstan te/ hrīḥhrīḥ zhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas bskor du bltas pas sgo rnams dbye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig dri bzang gi chu dang lag gnyis kyi srin lag gis phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgor 'jug pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbye bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shar du phyogs par 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rtsig pa 'dri zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can rnams ni grol byed pa/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang na yang dag gnas/ /zhes brjod cing nang nas rim pa bzhin/ sngo/ ljang / dmar/ ser/ dkar ba'i rtsig pa rnams sgo tshad gcig bris la/ ting la sogs pas kha bcad nas steng du ye thig gi rdo rje tshon skud dkris pa bzhag oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta hūm̐ gis bsrung / puṣpe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod la/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas dkar ser dmar ljang sngon pos rim bzhin bkang / de nas slob ma la sogs pas ci bde bar bris te/ de yang dbus kyi re mig sngo/ lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / ling tshe dgu pa'i phyi rol 'od zer phreng ba kha dog lnga pa/ de'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phreng ba/ gzhi sngon po la/ rdo rje dkar po/ 'dod yon dmar po la phyogs bzhir lha mo'i mtshan ma me tog bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug pha gu ser po la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa/ drwa phyed gzhi nag po la mu tig gi drwa ba drwa phyed/

mtshams su zla phyed rdo rje dang rin po ches spras pa/ shar bu dang mda' yab gzhi sngon po la shar bu dkar po dang / mda' yab padma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can bris pa'i bar bar du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyis mdzes pa/ rta babs kyi ka ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog ka rgyan mdzes tshon/ rta babs dang po dmar po/ gnyis pa sngo/ gsum pa ljang / bzhi pa ser ba'i dbus su glang rgyab la me tog dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa/ rta babs kyi steng padma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo ser po/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags ru ru'am yang na de mtshon byed tshon spungs ser po re re/ sgo 'gram dang zur rnams su zla phyed rdo rje re re/ mda' yab kyi zur rtse bzhi dang / rta babs 'khor lo'i steng du gdugs re re/ khyams ljang khu/ pad 'dab sna tshogs/ ge sar ser po/ de mthar chos 'byung mtshon phyed re kha dkar po/ rdo rwa'i gzhi nag rdo rje dkar po/ 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyis bskor ba bri'o/ /rtsig pa sbrel ran pa dang ting dang rdo rje bsal/ bzang ngan brtags la bzang na spro ba bskyed/ ngan na nam mkha'i lha la mchod gtor phul te 'khyil pas bsrung ngo / /mtshan ma 'god pa ni dbus dang / lho/ nub/ byang / sgo bzhi rnams su nyi ma/ shar dang / nang gi mtshams bzhi/ phyi'i mtshams bzhi/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon rnams su zla ba/ thams cad kyi 'og tu padma mtshon byed tshon spungs ljang khu/ dbus su ral gri sngo bsangs/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu padma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ljang khu/ nang gi mtshams bzhi'i shar lhor spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo/ lho nub tu rdo rje sngon po/ nub byang du padma dmar po/ byang shar du utpal sngon po/ de'i phyi rol lha snam la/ shar lhor me long / lho nub tu pi wang / nub byang du dung chos/ byang shar du thod pa/ shar sgo'i g.yas su gos/ g.yon du chos 'byung phyi dkar nang dmar/

shar sgor rdo rje tho ba/ lho sgor dbyug pa dkar po/ nub sgor padma dmar po/ byang sgor rdo rje rtse lnga pa nag po kha gyes pa rnams rang rang gi phyogs su mgo bstan pa dang / gtso bo'i mtshan ma nub phyogs su mgo bstan/ de tsam ma nus na so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod kyang rung ngo / /bri ba rdzogs pa dang tshon gyi lhag ma ye thig gi srad bu rnams phyogs gcig bzhag la gong bzhin puṣpe la sogs mchod pa lngas mchod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ thig tshon gyi ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mchod pa ci 'byor bshams la spos rol mo dang bcas/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang lhan cig rnam rgyal bum pa/ g.yon dril gsil/ slob mas las bum bzung la yig brgya brjod bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lha so so'i sngags kyis de dang der 'bul tshul byas la rang gi mgor gtugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod de/ rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi shar du bzhag de nas las bum slob dpon gyis thogs la/ oṃ āḥbighnan ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod cing bskor ba lan gcig gi mthar shar nas 'bul tshul byas la/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad las srung du gsol/ zhes brjod/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su bzhag go /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ legs bris dkyil 'khor de'i mthar/ chu gsum nyer spyod g.yas bskor bshams/ /sgos mchod ci tsam 'byor pa dang / /rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas dang / /bum gnyis gos zung dbu rgyan dang / /rdor gzungs dung chos maṇḍal sogs/

/'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad dang / /phyi rol gyi ni gtor ma la/ /nyer mkho stegs steng maṇḍal dbus/ /nas 'bras gang rung tshom bu gsum/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad dang shar gyi g.yon/ /nub byang g.yon dang nub kyi rgyab/ /g.yas g.yon du ni re re bkod/ /de mdun gtor ma g.yas phyogs su/ /chu gsum g.yon du nyer spyod lnga/ /mdun du nang mchod bcas pa'ang bshams/ /ras bris ltar na thig tshon gyi/ /byin gyis brlabs dang bum 'bul sogs/ /dor la bris thang mtshan nyid ldan/ /gzhi bzang steng du bkram pa'i mthar/ /spyi sgos mchod pa gru bzhir bshams/ /slob ma la dgos dbang rdzas sogs/ /zur bkod mtshams sbyor ji bzhin no/ /zhes pa ltar gyi sbyor ba'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'du byas nas/ dngos gzhi la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi bar sta gon bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur zhes pa'i rjes su/ rang skad cig gis dpal gsang ba 'dus par gyur/ zhes brjod nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣpe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐ sngags 'di'i shrī ye āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i āḥ'adi sde tshan 'di kho na ma gtogs gzhan mchod sngags kyi rigs la mi dgos/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe nas/ shapta'i bar dang / rū pa badzri sogs rdo rje ma lngas mchod la/ rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor du bzhugs par bsam la/ oṃ badzra be ga kra ma hoḥ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi mtshan ma dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal pa'i zhes pa nas bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs bdag skyed bzhin sgrub la/ oṃ āḥya manta kṛta dzaḥ zhes pa'i mthar/ spos rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin sogs nas/ sgrol ma dang dri rdo rje la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/

zhes pa'i bar nub dang po dkyil 'khor bteg pa thim par bsam sta gon bzhin bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba yid las byung / /bla med bstod bzlas gtor ma'o/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po phyi'i mchod pa la yang lnga yod pa'i dang po nyer mchod ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon sogs nas/ rol mo 'bul ba'i bar dang / gnyis pa gzugs sogs thabs kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa dang / gzugs sogs shes rab kyi ngo bor byas pa'i mchod pa rnams ni sta gon bzhin no/ /gsum pa thun mong gi mchod pa ni/ las kyi rlung bcu rnam par dag pa'i bdag /dri zhim utpal kha dog rnam lnga dang / /yid 'phrog me tog padma kha dog lnga/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa warṇa utpal padma pra tītstsha swāhā/ 'jug gnas ldang gsum rnam par dag pa'i bdag /mdzes shing yid 'ong shin tu dri zhim pa/ /me tog dza ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /rigs gsum dkyil 'khor lha'i tshogs la 'bul/ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba la/ tri warṇa dza ti pra tītstsha swāhā/ 'byung ba bzhi po rnam par dag pa'i bdag /karṇi ka dang ma li yu thi ka /ka ra bī ra me tog karṇi ka /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba la/ pañtsa puṣpaṃ/ 'di rnams dang / 'og nas 'byung 'gyur rin chen bdun me tog la pad kor sngon 'gro'i me tog gi phyag rgya kho na bya/ bzhi pa khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ /zag med bde ba'i ye shes bskyed byed pa'i/ /yon tan kun ldan na chung yid 'ong mchog /bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la 'bul/ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ yu ba ti/ zhes dang / pad kor 'khyud rgya/ zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing gzhan kun/ /mtha' yas bsod nams dpal las grub pa yis/ /rin chen padma rā gas rab bkang nas/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la 'bul/

/oṃ sarba sogs/ padma rā ga puṣpe pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhing khams 'di dang༞ /mtha' yas bsod nams༞ /rin chen ind+ra nī la'i༞ bla ma 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ sarba sogs/ ind+ra ni la puṣpe sogs/ zhing khams 'di dang༞ /mtha' yas༞ rin chen baiḍūrya'i༞ bla ma 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ sarba sogs/ baiḍūrya sogs/ zhing khams 'di dang༞ /mtha' yas bsod nams༞ /rin chen margad sogs kyis yongs bkang nas/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i༞ oṃ sarba sogs/ ma ra ka ta sogs/ zhing khams 'di dang༞ /mtha' yas bsod nams༞ /rin chen rdo yi snying pos rab bkang nas/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ sarba sogs/ usma garba sogs/ zhing khams 'di dang༞ /mtha' yas bsod nams༞ /rin chen mu tig tshogs kyis rab bkang nas/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ sarba sogs/ mukti ka sogs/ zhing khams 'di dang༞ /mtha' yas bsod nams༞ /rin chen byi ru'i tshogs kyis༞ /bla ma 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ sarba sogs/ pra bā ḍa puṣpe pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes kun gyi mjug tu sbyar/ lnga pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi mchod pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gdangs kyi khyad bcas tshig rkang dgu mar kho bos bsgyur ba lags/ stong gsum gyi ni zhing gi rdul snyed du/ /de snyed kyi ni bdag lus rnam bsam zhing / /mchod pa'i phyir ni dpag med sprul byas nas/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nirya ta na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ stong gsum gyi ni༞ /bdag nyid kyi ni lus ni rnam bsam zhing / /lce ni de snyed ldan dang bcas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa brjod par bya/ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ kā ya'i gnas su/ wāka nirya ta na bcug pa/ de ltar bdag gi rnam par sprul pa las/ /lus ngag sems las byung ba'i cho 'phrul ni/ /gcig tu bsdus nas dmigs med rgyas btab ste/ /sangs rgyas kun la 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/

/sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ wāka'i gnas su/ tsitta nirya ta na bcug pa 'di gsum gyi phyag rgya ni/ pad kor sngon 'gro'i sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba lus la dpral ba/ ngag la mgrin pa/ yid la snying khar bzhag pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa la lnga'i dang po nang gi nyer spyod ni/ gsang ba'i 'khor lo ind+ra nī la ltar/ /shin tu sngo ba'i rdo rje'i bung ba yis/ /bskyod pa'i padma las 'ong me tog dmar/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo gtum mo'i mes bsreg pa'i/ /yid 'ong dri yi ngad ldan ga bur spos/ /nyams su myong ba'i yid rab sim byed pa/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje༞ /oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus gnas bde ba'i dngos/ /hūm̐ yig nyi ma gsal ba'i 'od zer can/ /mi shes mun 'joms sngags kyi mar me 'di/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i༞ /oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus na legs gnas pa/ /kunda ltar dkar dri yi byug pa yis/ /lus kun khyab pas bde ba'i mchog ster ba/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje༞ /oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ rmi lam yul la rol ba ji bzhin du/ /gang gang dbang po'i lam nas byung nas ni/ /de dang de'i yul la longs spyod zas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i༞ /oṃ badzra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ snyoms 'jug dga' ba'i rol pa las byung ba'i/ /mi shigs ye shes mchog gi rol mo'i sgra/ /ā li kā li'i gdangs su shar ba rnams/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i༞ /oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ 'di rnams la pad kor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi mchod pa ni/ thabs shes dga' ba'i rol pa las byung ba'i/ /thabs kyi ye shes bde chen byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par rab spros nas/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i༞ /oṃ shi ra ti la ka pū dza āḥhūm̐/ gsum pa lus kyi rgyu mthun gyi mchod pa ni/

yum lnga'i rang bzhin dri chen dri chu dang / /byang sems dkar dmar sha chen dwangs ma ste/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi rgyu mthun bdud rtsi lnga/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i༞ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ bzhi pa bsgrub pa'i dam tshig gi mchod pa ni/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub 'gugs byed pa/ /ba glang khyi rta glang chen mi sha ste/ /bsgrub pa'i dam tshig dam pa lcags kyu lnga/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ pañtsa ma hā bā la pū dza āḥhūm̐/ 'di gsum la pad kor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du bslangs pa'i phyag rgya/ lnga pa chang gi mchod pa ni/ sta gon bzhin bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas bzung rigs drug tshim pa'i bar bya/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni sta gon bzhin/ mtshungs med sgyu 'phrul sgeg ma sogs/ lha mo drug gis mchod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pa la gsum las/ dang po bkra shis pa'i yo byad kyi mchod pa ni/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya hoḥ zhes brjod pas rgyal srid bdun dang / nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa mchod pa dpag tu med pa yid kyis sprul nas phul bar bsam la/ gser las grub cing rtsibs stong mu khyud ldan/ /dgra las rgyal byed 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mtha' gtugs pa/ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang lag pa gnyis bsnol la rgyab sbyar te sor mo bsnol ba'i phyag rgya/ dpag tshad du mar snang ba'i 'od 'gyed cing / /'dod dgu'i re bskong nor bu rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste༞ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ tsakra'i gnas su ma ṇi ratna zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur las mtheb mdzub sbyar nas rtse sprad pa/

phrag dog skyon bral bde ba'i dpal bskyed cing / /gzugs mdzes lta sdug bud med rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /ma ṇi'i gnas su wasatri ratna/ zhes dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba'i rgyab nas mdzub mo gnyis sbyar mthe bong gshibs pa/ chos min spangs shing 'gro la phan pa sgrub/ /mkhas gsal yid gzhung skyes bu rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /wasatri'i gnas su/ nā ra ratna༞ zhes dang / rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang / mthe bong gshibs pa/ thal dkar glang chen stong gi shugs kyi 'gro/ /yan lag bdun ldan glang po rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /nā ra'i gnas su/ gā dza ratna/ zhes dang / g.yon khro bo'i khu tshur bcing ba'i khar g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag la khu tshur bcangs shing mkhrig ma bkug pa/ 'dod pa'i gnas su skad cig tsam la bgrod/ /cang shes sprin shugs rta mchog rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gā dza'i gnas su/ a shwa ratna/ zhes dang / g.yas g.yon gyi gung srin gshibs te brkyangs la rtse sprad/ mthe chung mdzub mo bkug mtheb chen lto sbyar ba/ gang gis bcangs pas bdud dang mu stegs sogs/ /phas rgol tshar gcod ral gri rin chen gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /a shwa'i gnas su khaḍga ratna/ zhes dang / g.yas khro bo'i khu tshur kha nang bstan/ g.yon de 'dra ba phyi bstan gyi phyag rgya bya'o/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun ni/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i ral gri dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i lpags pa dang / /yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' mgu brtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod 'dir gdangs 'deg blta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thags bzang bsreg bcad mi nub 'jam pa'i gos/ /chu la mi bying ngal dub med pa'i lh+wam/

/'dir gdangs 'deg nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /sngags 'di bsgyur la oṃ sapta u pa ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs pa'i/ /bsod nams rgyu las byung ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /gang la phul ba de'i skad cig la/ /dam pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba sogs dang / maṅga la tsakra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /dri med shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /kun mkhyen ye shes nyid dang ldan par shog /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la shrīḥdzab pa na/ zhes dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /rin chen bcud kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /bsod nams tshogs rdzogs rgyan gyis brgyan par shog /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la kumbha zhes dang / thal mo sbyar ba las mthe chung gnyis kyi rgyab tu srin gung mdzub mo rnams rim bzhin sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs pa/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos padma 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /'khor ba'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos shog /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la padma zhes dang / thal mo kha phye ba/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /g.yas 'khyil shin tu dkar ba'i dung chen 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /smra ngan pham byed chos sgra sgrog par shog /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la shaṃ kha zhes dang / snyim pa'i thal mo las dung 'bud tshul/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /shin tu gsal ba'i mig ldan gser nya 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar shog /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la nya dza/ zhes dang / snyim pa'i thal mo mdun du brkyang ba chu khyer tshul/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /rgyan gyis spras pa'i rin chen gdugs mdzes 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /kun la skyabs kyi dam pa byed par shog

/gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la tsha ṭaṃ ka zhes dang / g.yon de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gyi khar g.yas kyi thal mo kha phub ste sbyar ba/ mgon po thugs rje༞ /dam chos mi nub rgyal mtshan dam pa 'di/ /gang la phul ba༞ /phyogs bcur chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par shog /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ maṅga la dhwa dza zhes dang / g.yas g.yon khro bo'i khu tshur bcangs la g.yon gyi khar g.yas brtsegs pa'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyer mkho'i mchod pa ni nyer mkho'i yo byad dpag tu med par sprul nas phul bar bsam la/ gdugs g.yab sbrang g.yab bsil g.yab skyed mos tshal/ /khyams dang gzim mal gdan khri glang chen rta/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing / /'dir gdangs 'deg rta babs bla re bza' btung ro mchog ldan/ /glu gar sna tshogs bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin chen lag dang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod/ /rab dkar dwang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags na/ /yid la 'dir gdangs 'deg 'dod pa'i don kun lhun grub shog /ra ri med cing lto che bre tshad ldan/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring zhabs zhum bcud kyis bkang / /gtsang ma'i gos dkris 'dab ldan lcug mas brgyan/ /'dir gdangs 'deg bdud rtsir ldan pa'i bum pa yis kyang mchod/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /bla re gdugs dang rgyal mtshan me tog phreng / /'dir gdangs 'deg ba dan sil snyan snyan pa'i rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod pa 'bul/ / 'di'i tshig rigs gdangs kyi khyad par can tshig rkang dgu ma dang / tshig bzhi ma la shlau ka'i tha snyad du byas pa'i dbang khang du bkod pa lags/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa mchod pa nyi shu pa ni/ gzugs mdzes mthong bas mi ngom reg na bde/ /yid 'phrog snyems ma'i tshul 'dzin sgeg mo yis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra lā sya pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang /

lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur sta zur g.yas g.yon du kha gyen bstan gyi phyag rgya/ ind+ra nī la la sogs 'jig rten na/ /shin tu dkon pa'i rin chen phreng mdzes kyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /sngags gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra mā le zhes dang / lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi thad nas kha phyir bstan pa phreng ba 'dzin tshul/ drug gi rjes su skyes sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /thos na tshim pa len byed glu ma yis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra gī ti/ zhes dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul/ gcig nyid du ma'i tshul du rab bstan nas/ /'gro ba dga' byed gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra nirti zhes dang / lag gnyis spyi bor thal mo bskor nas gar gyi tshul/ gser sogs rin chen las grub 'dab stong ldan/ /mdangs bkra yid 'ong dri ldan me tog gis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra puṣpe/ zhes dang / me tog gi phyag rgya/ a dkar nag sogs lhan cig skyes pa dang / /sbyar las byung ba'i bdug pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra dhū pe/ zhes dang / bdug pa'i phyag rgya/ nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i 'od la sogs/ /mun pa sel byed snang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra ā lo ke zhes dang / mar me'i phyag rgya/ reg na sim byed zhim pa'i dri ngad ldan/ /ga bur la sogs legs par sbyar ba'i chus/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra gandhe zhes dang / dri'i phyag rgya/ rten 'brel las byung skye med rang bzhin can/ /chos rnams skye med ston pa'i sil snyan sgra/

/nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra turyaṃ zhes dang / rol mo'i phyag rgya/ dge legs rin chen las grub g.yas su 'khyil/ /rgya chen chos kyi sgra sgrog dung dkar gyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ shaṃ kha/ zhes dang / dung gi phyag rgya/ gang gi lag pa bskyed pas khyad par las/ /sna tshogs rnar snyan bskyed byed gling bu'i sgra/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ waṃ sya/ zhes dang / g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo kha'i thad du gong 'og byas nas bkram pa'i phyag rgya/ gti mug rmongs pa'i rdul rnams sel byed pa'i/ /rnga yab dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ tsa ma ra zhes dang / 'dod chags tshad gdung skyobs pa'i bsil grib can/ /bkod legs kha dog cher bkra bsil yab kyis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ bi dha ma naṃ byañdza naṃ/ zhes dang / 'di gnyis ka la thal mo sbyar nas dpral ba'i g.yas g.yon du bskyod pa'i phyag rgya/ nor bu'i tog can dar gyi lhab lhub g.yo/ /mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal mtshan che/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ dhwa dza/ zhes dang / rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rgya/ bsam gtan bde ba bskyed byed lha yi gos/ /sna tshogs kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ badzra nai wi dyaṃ/ zhes dang / zhal zas kyi phyag rgya/ bde gshegs bzhugs gnas dga' ba'i skyed mos tshal/ /rin chen las grub khang brtsegs gru bzhi pas/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ ratna ku ṭaṃ ga ṭaṃ/ zhes dang / g.yas rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub gung gnyis brkyangs te nam mkhar khang brtsegs gru bzhi 'dri tshul/ srab 'jam yang ba shin tu dri zhim pa'i/

/lha rdzas na bza' kha dog sna lnga pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ wasatra zhes dang / rdo rje khu tshur gyi gos 'bul tshul/ rin chen gdub bu ske rags rkang rgyan dang / /rab mdzes rna cha mu tig do shal lnga/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ pañtsa ratna a laṅka ra/ zhes dang / rdo rje khu tshur gyis rgyan 'dogs tshul/ rab mdzes gos kyis steng g.yogs zlum por bres/ /sna tshogs dar gyi 'khor yug mdzes pa'i gdugs/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams༞ /bkang ste bcom ldan༞ /gong 'og 'dra ba las/ tsha traṃ ga zhes dang / gdugs kyi phyag rgya/ ting 'dzin snying rje'i rgyan phreng mdzes pa can/ /chos nyid don rtogs rin chen bla re yis/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthar thugs pa/ /bkang ste bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ta na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / g.yon mnyam bzhag g.yas nam mkha' la thal mo kha phub ste bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya'o/ /'di thams cad la sngon du pad kor sngags dngos gzhi la so so'i phyag rgya mjug tu se gol gtog pa ni kun la sbyar ro/ /de nas lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ bdag ming rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi bas/ /chos dbyings ngang las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mchod par 'tshal/ /thugs ni rab tu brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /mgon po bdag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /'di yang tshigs rkang dgu mar kho bos bsgyur ba lags/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pasd+ya na ya atma naṃ nirya ta ya mi/ zhes brjod la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo dud pa dang bcas se gol gtogs te lus phul bar bsam mo/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rang dkyil 'khor mchod pa po 'jam pa'i rdo rjer bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/

zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo / /lnga pa bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul rnams rang bzhin gyi mi dmigs par bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag cing / de'i don gsal 'debs pa ni/ rdo rje 'dir shur ma theg pa mnyes byed pa/ /'di ni don dam mchod pa yin/ /gang gi rnam rtog rnams spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing / /lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa/ /de yi mchod pa bla na med/ /sems can gang gis dbu ma yis/ /theg pa bsgom pa ma sgom na/ /theg pa dman la lhag par mos/ /de'i mchod pa kun rdzob yin/ /zhes brjod/ drug pa bstod pa'i mchod pa ni rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lnga pa dang / gang gi dngos kun gdod nas gsal bas mkha' bzhin zhi zhing dag /yang dag gsal bas bsres pa'i 'khor los kun 'das rab bzlog pa'i/ /rtag sogs rgyal ba bskyed byed 'gro kun de nyid gcig pa po/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed rnam par shes pa rnams/ /'khrul dang bral bas dri med phung po dngos por grub pa ste/ /'dod chags la sogs thabs kyis de bskyod mngon par byang chub phyir/ /sems don bdag bcas rnam rig las skyes rtag sogs de la 'dud/ /sa chu me rlung rang bzhin 'gyur cing tshangs spyod bzhi las skyes/ /'jo sgeg rol gdung rab tu brod pa'i yid dga' gang gi sems/ /sgyu ma'i sku yi rang 'byor mtha' ru de sgrol rab mkhas pa/ /rdo rje theg par 'gro ba'i lam mchog spyan ma la sogs de la 'dud/ /de bzhin mig la sogs pa'i gti mug dam tshig las byung zhing / /ma ning gnas su rgyas btab de las thams cad mkhyen pa skyes/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i lha'i mig sogs gang bar gsol mdzad pa/ /sa snying la sogs sems dpa' tshogs chen de la rab tu 'dud/

/gzugs la sogs pa'i spyod yul 'dul bar dga' ba nyams byas pa/ /bla na med pa'i 'dod pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor gang gi sems/ /tshim par mdzad pa 'di la sgrub bya mchog 'byung gang yin pa'i/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje la sogs lha mo tshogs chen de la 'dud/ /kun tu sbyor ba'i gdangs g.yos rab brgyan drag po'i cha lugs 'chang / /'jigs byed zhal bzhad sa 'dzin g.yo zhing thub skrag bsdigs las so/ /dad pa la sogs sems su gtogs dang de yi rang bzhin chos/ /dam par bzung sogs rnam dag gshin rje gshed sogs de la 'dud/ /shes rab chen po las skyes de rnams shin tu dag mdzad cing / /'jam zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i rgyud ni tshim mdzad pa/ /'bar zhing mdzes pa zur phud lnga ldan brgyad gnyis lon pa'i tshul/ /dbang po'i gzhu mtshungs 'jam dbyangs rdo rje de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'di tsi lu pas mdzad/ zhes dang / zhe sdang mthar mdzad mi bskyod rdo rje dngos/ /gti mug rab spangs 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i sku/ /'dod chags rnam dag yum dang rnam rol ba/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug bde ba che la 'dud/ /rnam shes rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dngos/ /gur kum mdog can bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /thugs kyi rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis/ /'gro ba'i zhe sdang sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs phung rnam dag me long ye shes dngos/ /ston zla'i mdog can rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad/ /sku yi rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis/ /'gro ba'i gti mug 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshor phung rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes dngos/ /gser zangs mdog can skyob pa rin chen tog /yon tan rigs kyi sprul pa༞ /'gro ba'i ser sna sbyong la༞ /'du shes rnam dag sor rtog ye shes dngos/ /li khri'i mdog can 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /gsung gi rigs kyi sprul pa༞ /'gro ba'i 'dod chags sbyong༞ /'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes dngos/

/margad mdog can dpa' bo don yod grub/ /'phrin las rigs kyi sprul pa༞ /'gro ba'i phrag dog sbyong la༞ /sa khams rnam dag thabs kyi phar phyin dngos/ /pad dkar mdog can yum mchog lha mo spyan/ /byams pa chen po'i gdul bya ma lus pa'i/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad la༞ /chu khams rnam dag smon lam phar phyin dngos/ /utpal mdog can rdo rje mā ma ki /snying rje chen pos 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /bsod nams rgyas par mdzad la༞ /me khams rnam dag stobs kyi phar phyin dngos/ /padma dmar po'i mdog can gos dkar mo/ /dga' ba chen pos skye rgu ma lus pa/ /thugs rjes dbang du sdud la༞ /rlung khams rnam dag ye shes phar phyin dngos/ /gur kum rgyas pa'i mdog can sgrol ma che/ /btang snyoms chen po'i sems can ma lus pa'i/ /gzung 'dzin gsod par mdzad la༞ /gzugs kyi skye mched rnam dag sbyin pa'i dngos/ /gangs ri'i mdog can gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /'khor lo'i rigs kyi rgyal ba ma lus rnams/ /gzugs kyi bde bas mchod la༞ /sgra yi skye mched rnam dag tshul khrims dngos/ /dbang sngon mdog can sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyal ba༞ /sgra yi bde bas mchod la༞ /dri yi skye mched rnam dag bzod pa'i dngos/ /gser bsregs mdog mtshungs dri yi rdo rje ma/ /rin chen rigs kyi rgyal ba༞ /dri yi bde bas mchod la༞ /ro yi skye mched rnam dag brtson 'grus dngos/ /nyi ma'i mdog can ro yi rdo rje ma/ /padma'i rigs kyi rgyal ba༞ /ro yi bde bas mchod la༞ /reg bya'i skye mched rnam dag bsam gtan dngos/ /dur ba'i mdog can reg bya'i rdo rje ma/ /ral gri'i rigs kyi rgyal ba༞ /reg bya'i bde bas mchod la༞ /chos kyi skye mched rnam dag shes rab dngos/ /chu shel mdog can chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyal ba rnams/ /chos khams bde bas mchod la༞

/ma dad smra dang phung po'i bdud sbyong zhing / /dad pa'i dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /sprin bral nam mkha'i mdog can gshin rje'i gshed/ /bde gshegs 'gugs par mdzad la༞ /le lo che dang nyon mongs bdud sbyong zhing / /brtson 'grus dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /rab dkar zla ba'i mdog can shes mthar byed/ /rgyal rnams gzhug par mdzad la༞ /brjed ngas blo dang 'chi bdag bdud 'dul zhing / /dran pa'i dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /gzil chen nyi ma'i mdog can pad mthar byed/ /bde gshegs bcing bar mdzad la༞ /rnam g.yeng lha yi bu yi bdud 'joms shing / /ting 'dzin dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos/ /rgya chen rgya mtsho'i mdog can bgegs mthar byed/ /bde gshegs mnyes par mdzad la༞ /kun kyang sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing / /rab mdzes dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras/ /sprul pa'i 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba can/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku che la༞ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin yab yum sku/ /phan tshun zung 'jug sbyor ba'i rol pa yis/ /chags chen skyes bu'i 'dod chags sbyong mdzad pa/ /mkha' sbyor dam pa'i sku la༞ /'jig rten lha mi'i bde ba ma lus pas/ /dpe dang char yang gzhal bar mi nus pa'i/ /bde chen ye shes che la rtag rol ba/ /'gyur med bde chen sku la༞ /chos kun rang bzhin rten 'byung zab mo'i dngos/ /'od gsal zhi ba spros bral dam pa'i don/ /zab gsal gnyis med ye shes mchog brnyes pa/ /rang bzhin med pa'i sku la༞ /dmigs med snying rje'i chu rlabs g.yo ba'i mthus/ /ma lus gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin stsol mdzad pa/ /snying rjes yongs gang sku la༞ /sna tshogs sku yi sprul pa bsam yas kyis/ /bar dang phyogs dus rgyun chad yod med par/ /rnam mang 'gro la phan pa mchog sgrub pa'i/ /rgyun mi chad pa'i sku la༞ /rgya chen thugs rjes gzhan la brtser dgongs nas/

/ji srid 'khor ba'i 'khrul pa ma zhig bar/ /de srid mya ngan 'da' ba'i skabs med pa'i/ /'gog pa med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' yas na/ /rab mdzes mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis rnams/ /rab mchog zhing gi dam pa 'jam dbyangs la/ /rab dkar dad pa'i sems kyis rgyas par 'bul/ 'dir ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa bzlas pa'i mchod pa dang brtan byed kyi bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ brgya rtsa dang / oṃ āḥdzi na dzika nas/ bighnan ta kṛta hūm̐ gi bar gsum re dang / thun mong du yig brgya nyer gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bye ste/ rdo rje shugs kyis 'jug pas rang gi gnas su 'khod/ ces brjod la/ sgrub grogs gcig bighnan ta kṛ'i sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ dpon slob rnams kyis sgrub khang gi phyi rol lam/ yang na dkyil 'khor yol bas chod pa'i phyir gong du bshad pa'i phyi rol gtor ma'i yo byad rnams khyer la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas/ mchod pa la 'thor tshul dang / bighnan gyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i zhes pa nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyi mchod pa byin rlabs mchod phreng gi gong bzhin dang / yang rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor ma la 'thor tshul dang / gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod thod par gyur pa'i zhes pa nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin/ rang 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i zhes pa nas thams cad kyang gsang ba 'dus pa'i skur gyur pa ni/

zhes pa'i bar gtor bsngo bzhin la/ shar gyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma/ de'i g.yon gyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje sgyu ma sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis dung dang padma/ shar lho'i tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje me dmar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang gaṇḍe/ lho'i tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje dus nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang rin po che/ lho nub kyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje gtum shing nag po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang thod khrag nub kyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje glu dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis sbrul zhags dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang rin po che/ nub byang gi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje rlung ljang khu don grub kyi cod pan can/ ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis gos dang ral gri/

g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang rin po che/ de'i g.yon gyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje sna ring dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis dung dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang chang gis bkang ba'i kham phor/ byang gi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis bi dza pu ra dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ne'u le/ byang shar gyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje khro bo dkar po 'od dpag med kyi cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma/ dbus kyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje 'od dkar po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dkar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo/ de'i g.yas kyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje 'khyil pa nag po rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gyi tshom bu'i steng du rdo rje mi smra ser po rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo/ phyi rol rgyab kyi tshom bu'i steng du thags bzang ris sngon po mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/

g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma/ de'i g.yon gyi tshom bu'i steng du sa'i lha mo ser mo rnam snang gi cod pan can/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi thabs la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma ser po dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo/ thams cad kyang sna tshogs padma'i steng du rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha'i gos dang phreng ba dang byugs pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad nye bar 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ de la chu gsum nyer spyod rdo rje ma lnga/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ nang mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs bstod pa nas/ bsrung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig gi sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin byas la/ de nas sgrub grogs kyi zhal zas nas mchod yon gyi bar du rim pas gtor snod du blug la snod rnams kha sbub/ dpon slob rnams kyis yig brgya lan gsum badzra sa twa sogs/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs shlau ka gcig gis bzod par gsol/ mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes dang / mchod g.yog pas/ bsang gtor gyi chu gtor ma la g.yas su bskor te 'gro phyogs su gtor ro/ /dpon slob rnams kyis/ oṃ ā ka ro sogs nas na te hūm̐ muḥ nyin rjes ma'i nyin ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la thim/ nyin snga ma rnams la dkyus bzhin ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi dgos/ zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis rang dang sgrub grogs rnams kyi gnas gsum bsrung la/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la zhes pa nas gtor ma dor te/ bighnan ta kṛta/ brjod cing rol mo dang bcas slob dpon gyis rting mnan la nang du log

gshong na dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya zhing / mi gshong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas byas par bsam la shar sgo'i thad du langs nas yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ de nas rdor dril dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs shlau ka gcig dang / gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la/ skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra be ga kra ma hoḥs dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phul/ sngags de nyid kyis rang gi mgo bor bcings/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ nub sgo nas g.yon brkyangs kyi shar sgo phye/ de bzhin du byang sgo nas lho dang / shar nas nub dang / lho nas byang sgo dbye bar bsam la/ oṃ badzra ud gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes lan bzhi brjod la gong gi phyag rgya bcing ba dang 'grol ba lan bzhi byas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig zhes brjod nas rang gnas su 'dug la/ chu gsum nyer spyod bdud rtsi rnams gtor bsngo bzhin phul ba'i rjes su/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / dril bu tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su dkrol la gdangs dang bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ 'khor ba don byed sku 'dzin pa/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor bas mchod/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje khyod 'ba' zhig /te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐ te na te te hūm̐/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi padma la/ /lha dang mi yis 'dud pas mchog /sprul pa'i me tog sna tshogs dag /'jam pa'i rdo rje khyod 'ba' zhig /te na sogs/ dngos po rnam grol rnam par bsnyen/

/gsang ba'i gsang ba 'dzin pa khyod/ /bdud rtsi mtha' med gsol ba khyod/ /khyod kyi dgongs pa sangs rgyas yin/ /te na sogs/ rtsom spangs sems can don byed pa/ /rgyu med gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /te na sogs/ dung dang ku mu da yi gzugs/ /rgya mtsho dwangs ma'i zla gzugs 'dra/ /te na sogs/ rol pa gnyis med rnal 'byor mdzad/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya 'dzin/ /te na sogs/ /sgyu 'phrul lus kyis 'gro ba bzung / /rkyen gyis ma byas gzugs can yin/ /te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐ te na te te hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad la skabs 'dir bum bskyed mdzad/ ༈ de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba la gnyis te/ 'jug pa dang dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni bla ma'i bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gi byas par bsam la/ khrus kyi dod du las bum gyi chu nas cung zad cig 'thung la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gi khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ 'jug pa'i yon du/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i mthar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi thad pa la dbang gi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes pa dang / bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thal mo sbyar nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /lan gsum/ gang zhig thog med nas/ da ni gnas par bgyi'i bar lan gsum/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/

/bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba'i/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi tshogs dpag tu med par spros te/ bdag nyid dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ zhes dang / las bum gyi chu gtor la/ bighnan gyis bsangs/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong 'ching tshul/

sdug pa khyod su/ zhes bris/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po la/ zhes lan btab/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog bzung / snying kha nas yon sprul te phul bar bsam la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ yul mkhar khyim dang glang po rta/ /bran dang bran mo chung ma sdug /bu mo shin tu yid 'ong dang / /gang gis rang gi lus 'di yang / /deng nas brtsams te 'bul bar bgyi/ /slob dpon du ni nyer gnas phyir/ /rdo rje chen po nyer gnas phyir/ /sems can thams cad skyabs don du/ /bdag gi lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi/ /zhes pas yon phul/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da ya mi zhes pas nang gi sems bskyed/ snying khar rdo rje reg la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ hoḥsiddha badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par bya/ de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥya manta kṛta dzaḥ oṃ āḥpra dzñānta kṛta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadmanta kṛta baṃ/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta hoḥ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par bsam/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi ngas khyod la ye shes gang dang gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ las bum gyi chu dang nang mchod nas myang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badzra u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas te dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung cig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du sogs/ thal mo sbyar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzod cig lan gsum/ rang nyid 'od 'di la zin bris rnams las zhal phyag bsal 'debs ma gsungs kyang 'dir bkod pa dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir 'phags lugs kyi dkyil chog rnams las gsungs pa bzhin bris pa lags/ dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ langs nas yod pa'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor mchog ma la ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su dzñaiṃ me'i rang bzhin/

sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa'i mtshams bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa la hūm̐/ mgrin par waṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa la ha/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon zla gaṃ as mtshan pa rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos pas dzhaiṃ las me 'bar/ sum mdo'i me dang gcig tu bsres shing cher 'bar/ snying ka'i sa tshig mgrin pa'i chu khol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan cing / rlangs pa ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kha ba babs pa ltar spyan drangs/ dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas thim/ zhes brjod la rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu drag tu dkrol rol mo'i sgra bya zhing / a be sha ya staṃ bha ya/ rā rā rā rā/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ zhes yang yang brjod de dbab/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pas brtan par byas/ nam mkha'i kha dog la brten nas dngos grub ngos bzung / pra tītstsha badzra hoḥs me tog 'bul ba'i stangs ka bya/ de sngags su byas nas rang gi mgo la bcings par bsam la me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ pra ti gṛhna satwaṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ mig dar dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi phyag gis bsal ste/ mig gnyis su oṃ 'od 'bar ba re bsam la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /zhes brjod/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha ngo bstan pa bzhin gsal bar mthong bar mos la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad/ sku dang tsaka li lta bu ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur mthong ba yin no/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbang gi dngos gzhi la gnyis te/

rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang / slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /dang po ni/ dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi ma sogs nas/ tha mi dad pa la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i sogs thal mo sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar gsol ba bzhin/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyang ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /las bum gyi chu ku shas rang dang dbang rdzas la gtor la/ bighnanagyis bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ sna tshogs pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ āḥya manta kṛta dzaḥnas/ bighnan ta kṛta hoḥba'i bar/ bdag dang dbang rdzas la thim/ de'i mig tu sa snying dkar po zhes pa nas/ spyi bor sku rdo rje dkar po'i bar sta gon gyi mjug bzhin/ slar yang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ phyag rgya gong bzhin/ rnam rgyal gyi bum chu de'i ku shas de la gtor la/ oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang rdzas kyis lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ thal mo sbyar la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /gsang ba gsum ni gnas nas byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin par bya/ /bum chu cung zad 'thung zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rnams bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ 'di'i rigs kyi 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par byas la/ rang dang dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ gnyis ka'ang rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang padma 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i sogs nas/ bzhugs pa gtso bo'i thugs ka nas༞ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya/ ya manta kṛta sogs/ dgug gzhug bcings mnyes/ mig tu sa snying / sogs skye mched thugs gsung sku byin gyis brlabs/ 'di man chad la dbang lha spyan 'dren dor la/ badzri bha wa sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/

de bzhin gshegs pa༞ rin chen chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ gzhan 'dra/ oṃ ratna mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes pas dbu rgyan gyon/ badzri bha wa sogs rnam rgyal bum chu gtor la/ zhes gsung zhing nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs/ gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis padma dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i sogs nas bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyi rnam par rdo rje bsdus pa'i sngags rgya/ ya man nas/ thim/ mig tu sa snying sogs/ oṃ badzri nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med sogs nas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ rdo rje lag g.yas su bzung la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /badzri sogs nas/ dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ sogs/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rang dang dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te/

sogs/ stong pa'i sogs/ gnyis ka'ang don grub ljang khu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i nas/ bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka sogs nas/ don yod grub pa'i rnam par/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya/ ya man nas/ thim/ mig tu sa snying sogs/ oṃ badzri nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa sogs nas/ dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ dril bu dkrol la/ oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bar mos la rdor dril snying khar 'khyud rgya bya/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma satwaṃ/ oṃ badzri sogs nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /rang nyid bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po rnam snang dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang padma 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i sogs nas/ bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka sogs nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya/ ya man nas hoḥ'i bar/ mig tu sa snying nas/ sku rdo rje dkar po'i bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas gsol gyi bar/ rdor dril lhan cig tu dkrol la/ oṃ badzra satwa satwaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ badzra nā ma/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa a bhi ṣe ke ta/
