zhes pas ming dbang bskur oṃ badzri nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyis sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon nam bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /dbang de dag gi don ni/ rang gi dngos kun gang gang snang / /gtso cher de ni 'jam rgyal rang / /chos rnam rang bzhin gyis dag pas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gang yin de'o/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ dngos kun gdod nas dag pa glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs pa rnams cho ga 'di dag gis sel bar byas pas deng phyin chad dag pa'i ye shes su blta bar bya'o snyam du bsam/ rang nyid bsangs sbyangs/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis sogs/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis nor bu dang padma 'dzin pa/ mdzes pa'i ral pa'i sogs nas/ bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya/ ya man nas thim/ mig tu sa snying nas/ sku rdo rje dkar po'i bar/ oṃ badzri nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje gyur/ lag g.yas kyis gsor te/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ka satwaṃ/ dha ra ya mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes dang / snying khar bzung la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/

/rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i mchog /de ltar na thugs kyi dbang thob/ mi rtog pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'grub cing / dam tshig tu rdo rje sangs rgyas kyi thugs yin no/ /dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ zhes brjod cing dkrol la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /shes rab sgra yi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /dku g.yon par kha gyen du phyogs pas bzung la/ srid pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar na gsung gi dbang thob/ ngag bzlas pa la dbang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'grub cing / dam tshig tu dril bu sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin no/ /rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku thams cad dang zhal gyi gtso bo gur kum gyi mdog lta bu/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri ljang khu dang mda'/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis utpal sngon po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang nor bu'i dbu brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ sna tshogs pa'i na bza' gsol ba/ zla ba'i 'od dang zla ba'i gdan mnga' ba/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ zhes dang rdor dril thugs kar bsnol nas/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis/ /gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzlas/ /rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo de/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi zad pas/ /bsten na mi snang mngon shes dang /

mkha' la rgyu dang lus ngag yid/ /las byung dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyod pa rnams/ /'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis/ /chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes so/ /bde dang sdug bsngal de dag min/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten/ /ye shes don gnyer 'dod chags can/ /sbyor bas bsgom na myur du 'grub/ /sku gsung thugs ni yang dag 'grub/ /gang gzhan dman par bshad pa ni/ /sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur ba/ /sku gsung thugs ni bsgom pas so/ /de nyid kyis ni rdo rje bzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi ni phyag rgya cher/ /byin gyis brlabs la snying po bzlas/ /de ltar na sku'i dbang thob/ lha sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu gzugs kyi sku 'grub cing / dam tshig tu gzugs sku la sangs rgyas dngos yin no/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal gling bzhi sogs nas tha mi dad pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ thal mo sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor padma 'dab ma brgyad pa dar gyis bkab pa'i steng du rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskyar nas bskur bar mos te/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag nas/ rdo rje chen po'i sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar bum chu 'thung / rin chen chen po'i sogs sngags dang bcas rdo rje gsor la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sogs/ dril bu dkrol la/ oṃ badzra a dhi sogs dang / rdor dril lhan cig tu dkrol la/ oṃ badzra satwa nas/ a bhi ṣe ke ta'i bar rnams gong bzhin brjod pa'i rjes su/ de ltar na rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas/

nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa dag rnam shes la sogs pa phung po lnga gnas gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang / ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin mngon du byas pa yin no/ /yang bum pa thogs la/ rdo rje chen po'i sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /sogs shlau ka gsum gyi mthar/ bum pa mgo la reg chu cung zad 'thung la/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ oṃ su pra tīṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes dang / me tog gtor/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ de nas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ mi mnyam med pa zur bzhi pa/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas mi mnyam nyid/ /lus tshor sems dang chos rnams kyi/ /gcig dang sna tshogs sbyor bral nyid/ /de dran de la dad pa gang / /shar sgo byang chub phyir 'dod do/ /de las byung dang 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /phyin ci log spangs mi bskyed bya/ /ma skyes skyes pa'i yang dag kyang / /bskyed pa dang ni gnas bya ba/ /brtson 'grus rnam bzhi lho'i sgo/ /'dun dang spro dang gnas dang blo/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang dang dran pa 'dir/ /nub kyi sgo ni yin par bshad/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /shes rab dbang thob mnyam med de/ /ting nge 'dzin yang byang de ltar/ /dran dang dbang po sgo bzhi yin/ /dang po la sogs bsam gtan bzhi/ /rta babs bzhir ni 'byung ba yin/ /dpa' bar 'gro dang mkha' mdzod sogs/ /ting 'dzin kha khyer yin par bshad/ /lag na mchod thogs dbyen spyo rnams/ /tshig la sogs pa'i gzungs tshogs yin/ /gang phyir sna tshogs rgyan ldan pa/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa'o/ /gdul bya bskyod pa dam pa'i chos/ /yan lag dbu skra kun grol ba/ /ba dan sna tshogs rlung gis bskyod/

/rtse mo dril btags sgra sgrog yin/ /ye shes me long byang yan lag /phyogs dus kun gyi 'od rab gsal/ /drwa ba drwa phyed nyi zla dang / /rnga yab me long me tog phreng / /de yi 'khor lo sogs ka ba/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sbyangs pa yin/ /de yi nang gi 'khor lo de/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa lta bu yin/ /phyogs kun dus gsum rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje theg pa rab ston pa'i/ /kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /rdo rje'i thig gis bskor ba yin/ /ye shes kyis 'gro la zhen pa'i/ /tshon ni rdzogs sangs rgyas lnga yin/ /dbang po don sogs rnam dag pas/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dben pa nyid/ /shes rab ye shes bdud rtsi ni/ /rdo rje can gsol bum pa'ang de/ /tshogs rdzogs pa yi rgyu mthun pa/ /thugs rje rlan nyid bum pa gang / /dkyil 'khor gang du me tog spos/ /mar me che dang drir bshad pa/ /byang chub yan lag yid rab tshim/ /chos kyi snang ba grags bsdus yin/ /chos kyi zas ni lha bshos yin/ /ngo tsha khrel yod pa yi gos/ /glu gar snyan dang rol mo rnams/ /bde ba chen po rnams 'phel ba'o/ /grong khyer thar pa'i grong khyer bas/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa yin/ /'khor lo'i de nyid legs bstan nas/ /lha yi de nyid bstan par bya/ /dad dang brtson 'grus dran bsam gtan/ /rnam dag sgo bsrung mchog gi gzugs/ /sku sogs 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor sems/ /shes rab dag pa rab dri med/ /sbyin sogs drug po'i phyi rol dag /gzugs rdo rje la sogs rang bzhin/ /sa thabs la sogs mtshan med phyir/ /spyan la sogs pa'i ngo bo yin/ /don dang sems can bdag kun rtog /'jug pa'i shes pa rnam dag pa/ /me long la sogs ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo yin/ /ma skyes ye shes sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo lta bur snang / /gzugs sogs 'khrul pa legs dag pa/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/

/ser sna la sogs gnas gyur pa/ /pha rol phyin par shin tu gnas/ /rang gi mi mthun gnas gyur pa/ /stobs sogs tshang zhing dri ma med/ /rnam par mi rtog zab pa dang / /rgya che bar ni rang bzhin 'byung / /zab dang rgya che 'di dag nyid/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid gang ste/ /so so rang rig chos yin phyir/ /dbye yod dbye med sogs mi gnas/ /de ltar spros par gyur pa ni/ /pha rol phyin sogs 'bras bur snang / /zhes brjod la/ rjes gnang ni/ de bzhin slob ma dbang bskur dang / /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni rab bstan pas/ /gang zag gnyis su shes par bya/ /gzugs brnyan glegs bam la sogs pa/ /yod na khyod kyis rab gnas mdzod/ /de ni ji srid bar du ni/ /sems can don du 'gyur bas so/ /de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag par byas shing bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob par byed pa yin no/ /zhes ngo sprod/ gsang dbang gi rten du phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'bul zhing / maṇḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ tha mi dad pa la gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du sogs/ thal mo sbyar nas/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs 'ching tshul byas la/ bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum zag pa med pa'i bde ba la snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka'i maṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi sku rnams spyan drangs nas yab yum gyi zhal du thim/ thugs kar zhu nas gsang ba'i mthar/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa/ rang nyid blo brtan pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi lce thog tu bzhag oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myang bas bde ba sna tshogs kyis lus gang bar bsam la cung zad mnyam par bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs phye la/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang gis ngag gi dri ma dag

rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang / sgyu lus sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par byed pa yin no/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ maṇḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ tha mi dad pa la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du 'bul ba sogs dang / thal mo sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs 'ching tshul/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas mtshan ldan gyi rig ma zhig phyag rgyar gnang bar bsam la/ gzungs 'di shin tu yid 'ong ste/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis btags/ /'khor lo rim gyi rab sbyor bas/ /bde ba dam pa yang dag sbyar/ /zhes gnang ba de nyid pang du byon par bsam la/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swa ser po/ padma'i dbus su a dkar po/ brla rtsar ha ljang khu/ yab kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu'i bu gar phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi padma hūm̐ las padma dmar po/ a las byung ba'i ze 'bru'i bu gar phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ zhes brjod la phan tshun 'khyud tshul byas pas dga' ba/ mnyam par sbyar bas mchog dga'/ bsrub cing bsrub pas dga' bral/ byang sems dkar dmar lhan cig tu 'dzom lhan cig skyes pas dga' bde mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes/ slar yar drangs lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad du bkram pas lus thams cad bde bas gang bar mos la/ rdo rje'i skyil krung nyid dang sems/ /nor ldan khongs su rtog par blta/ /dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnam dag /rab gsang shes rab mchog gis ni/ /dbang bskur de nyid yang dag bshad/ /ces brjod la 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs dkrol/ de ltar na yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gsum pas gtso cher sems kyi dri ma sbyong zhing gzhan lus phyag rgya bsgom pa la dbang /

'bras bu chos sku thob par byed pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa la/ maṇḍal gling bzhi sogs nas/ tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du sogs gsol 'debs 'dra/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcings la/ bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med par mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes brjod la don bsam pa ni/ de mtshon bya mtshon byed du gsungs pas mtshon bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de'i mtshan nyid phyi rol pa'i bdag gi dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing / nyan thos sde gnyis smra ba'i phung khams skye mched gyi chos dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs la rnam rig pas gnyis med kyi shes pa tsam gyi rtag pa dang yang bral ba'i/ rang sems gsal la ma 'gags pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid de nyid yan lag bdun ldan gyi sangs rgyas yin zhing / de dbang gsum pa'i ye shes 'di'i mtshon nus pa la tshig gi ngo sprod pa ni tshig dbang bzhi pa ste/ ji ltar na/ gsum pa'i dus su lha sku zhal sbyor gsal la ma 'gags pa/ sems rgyud zag med bde bas gang ba/ bde ba'i ngo bo la bltas na phyi rol pa'i bdag gnas/ rnam rig pa'i gnyis med kyi shes pa'i bar gyi rnam rtog gang yang ma grub pa nam mkha' lta bu yin la/ de yang dmigs med snying rjes 'gro don rgyun mi chad pa yin pas de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag 'bru gsum gyi gdong g.yogs phye/ de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob par byed pa yin no/ /dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i dam tshig ni/ dbang bskur 'di ni ji ltar bar/

/byang chub spyod bzhin de bzhin du/ /dge ba'i tshul ni gzhan gsungs pas/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs thob mi 'gyur/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsrung ba dang / /rtag tu sdom pa bskyang bar bya/ /bcu phyed sgron ma mi 'chi spyad/ /dam tshig gzhan yang bsrung ba ni/ /dkon mchog gnod gzhom bud med ni/ /mchog myang log pa'i lam ma yin/ /'di dag cho ga bzhin du bsrung / /rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ lung bstan pa ni/ g.yon khu tshur gyis chos gos snying khar bzung g.yas mchod sbyin du bya ba ni/ oṃ ngas khyod 'di ltar lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa'i mtha' ni grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton/ /kyai de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba/ siddhi sa ma ya satwaṃ bhurbhu ba swa/ 'di yi dbang bskur gyur pa yi/ /sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi bdag /bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ /bde gshegs kyis kyang lung bstan mdzad/ /de yang lam gyi dus su sems can sna tshogs kyi don byed cing thun bzhir ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi sbyor bas thun mong gi dngos grub mi snang ba dang / mngon shes dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa dang / mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje 'chang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas sgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba dang gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di/ /mthong ba dang ni zhugs gyur pa/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol bar/ /khyod rnams 'di nyid legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ /slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te/ /mi tshugs pa dang ma chod pa/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dam tshig sdom pa 'grub pa 'di/

/rtag tu khyed kyis bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /dam pa rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun tu dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni btang mi bya/ /phyag na rdo rje gang yin pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi spang zhing / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yi/ /tshul chen bsten par mi bya'o/ /bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas su/ /dka' thub kyis ni ma gdungs shing / /ci bde bar ni bde bas bzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang yongs su mi gtong zhing / /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yis/ /slob dpon la ni gang smod pa/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas/ /rtag tu duḥkha thob 'gyur te/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas sems dmyal ltung bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge ba rab tu mi bcom pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus byas yod/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis sbyin par bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung / /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang 'bul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /de byon sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byon bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs pas dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /gang phyir 'di ni legs gnas pa/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par/ /deng khyod 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa/ /kun gyis deng khyod dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che/

/rgyal po'i bdag por brten pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /khyed rnams kyi ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /deng nyid thob par the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dwangs rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde bskyed brtan par gyis/ /deng ni 'gro las myur bde rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rab tu mnyam zhing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod/ dam tshig bsdus te bzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhabs la phyag btsal bar mos nas/ thal mo sbyar la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa'i/ /gsung ni de bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /lan gsum/ gtang rag du yon 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul ba'i mthar/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang bskur zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du 'bul bar sogs/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang mthun pa lan gsum/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ rdo rjes phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / dril bu tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su dkrol la/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal mchog gi /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cig

/sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing / /sems can kun gyi snying la 'jug /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa/ /bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan gsal ba slob ma ni/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /zhes lan gsum brjod/ brgyad pa gtor mas mchod pa ni/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas bzung / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma phul/ bskang ba rnams sta gon gyi skabs bzhin byas la slob ma dbang bskur bya dgos na zur du 'chad pa'i mtshams sbyor bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ phyi mchod rdo rje ma lnga bcas/ nang mchod de nyid lnga pas bstod pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ lhag chad kha bskang ba/ bzod gsol rnams sta gon bzhin bya/ sgrub mchod snga ma rnams la/ khyad par du yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra sogs brjod la me tog gtor/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol/ skye mched thugs gsung sku bsrung ba/ bsngo ba smon lam rnams sta gon bzhin la/ de tshe bdag gis 'dul gyur cig /zhes pa'i rjes su/ de ltar rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab dang / /ye shes gcig bsdus rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la/

/bdag gis mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /rnam dag dge ba'i bshes dang mjal bar shog /yongs 'dzin mkhas pas rjes su bzung gyur pas/ /'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal rang bzhin du/ /legs par rtogs nas de dag rab spangs te/ /ma nor thar pa'i lam du 'jug par shog /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor drin chen pha ma rnams/ /sdug bsngal chu bo chen pos khyer mthong ste/ /de rnams bsgral phyir snying rjes yid drangs nas/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems mchog skye bar shog /lam gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims rnam gsum dang / /zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam/ /pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs/ /rgya chen byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /rgyal sras lam gyi rang rgyud dag pa'i tshe/ /tshul khrims dag cing 'dus pa'i rgyud la mkhas/ /de nyid bcu shes nyan thos spyod ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mnyes byed shog /rmad byung dkyil 'khor chen por bum pa'i dbang / /rnam dag cho gas tshul bzhin bskur ba'i mthus/ /phung khams lha yi rnam par dag byas nas/ /rgya chen bskyed rim snod du 'gyur bar shog /lus kyi dbang po bha ga byang sems kyi/ /dkyil 'khor zab mor mchog dbang gsum bskur bas/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum bde bar byin brlabs nas/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i snod du 'gyur bar shog /dbang dus cho gas thob dang khas blangs pa'i/ /bsrung dang mi spangs za ba'i dam tshig rnams/ /tshul bzhin bsten pas nyes tshogs kun bcom nas/ /sngags kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag par shog /dbang gis mtshon pa'i yang dag lta ba'i don/ /chos rnams nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa/ /zab gsal gnyis med bde chen lhan cig skyes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par shog /tha mal rnam rtog kun bcom bskyed rim lam/ /chung dang bar ma chen po'i rim pa yis/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi dang ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum/

/thun bzhir bsgom pas lha snang mthar phyin shog /lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /rgyal ba mchod dang sems can smin byed sogs/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la rab 'bad pas/ /'khor bar skye ba'i las kun dag par shog /chos sku rnam thar sgo gsum rang bzhin du/ /legs par rtogs nas spros bral dam pa'i don/ /ye shes tshogs kyi rnal 'byor legs bsgom pas/ /nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i drwa ba zhi bar shog /rnal 'byor 'bras bu mngon du byas pa'i tshe/ /gnas rnams rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang / /bkod legs dbyibs mdzes dam par sgrub pa'i rgyu/ /zhing kun dag pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /gzhi la gnas pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum/ /ji ltar grub bzhin lam du byas pa las/ /'bras bu sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i lam/ /dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /thabs shes sgyu ma bde ba'i rol pa las/ /shes rab padmar byang sems las 'khrungs pa/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa las/ /bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin skye bar shog /'gro ba'i don du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar rab spros nas/ /sna tshogs mdzad pas sems can smin byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /'od gsal bskyed pa thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / /sems rab brtan byed phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang / /dngos grub 'gugs pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /las rgyal mchog gi ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /thun mtshams kun tu sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgo gsum dge ba'i spyod pa ci byed pa/ /de kun lha yi rol par shes byed pas/ /las dang spyod lam rnam par dag par shog /de ltar rim pa dang po'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /cir snang lha yi 'khor lor legs grub nas/ /lam bzang des kyang chog par mi 'dzin pa/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i lam la 'jug par shog /sna rtse gsum dang sbyor ba yan lag drug

/khyad par dngos po'i mtha' las rnam grol ba'i/ /man ngag rgyal po grol ba'i thig le la/ /thos bsam tshul gyis sgro 'dogs chod par shog /snying ka'i padma 'od zer lnga ldan pa'i/ /mi shigs thig le 'dzag pa'i ngang tshul can/ /dngos po rkyen gyi mtha' yi de bzhin nyid/ /tshul bzhin sgom pas ye shes mchog thob shog /nor bu'i dbus su bde gshegs zhu ba'i rgyun/ /rdul mun snying stobs tshul du babs pa las/ /gsang ba'i thig le ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /spro bsdus bsgom pas rjes dran mthar phyin shog /lus kyi gnas bzhir 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi rang bzhin yig 'bru bzhi/ /rang bzhin bzlas pa'i tshul gyis goms byas pas/ /sprul pa'i thig le'i rnal 'byor 'grub par shog /yon tan kun gyi 'byung gnas mi shigs pa'i/ /thig le'i 'od kyis khams gsum ma lus pa/ /'od gsal zhi ba'i dbyings su rab bsdus nas/ /slar yang zung 'jug snang ba rgyas byed shog /de ltar dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed byed pa/ /thig le bzhi yi rnal 'byor dam pa dang / /rig ma brtul zhugs spyod pa legs spyad pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang thob shog /phyin ci log gi rnam pa kun dang bral/ /bsam brjod las 'das mkha' bzhin dri ma med/ /gsal bas ye shes kun 'byung rnam rtog spangs/ /gting dpag dka' ba'i zab mo mthar phyin shog /chos dbyings las byung phyag rgya chen po'i sku/ /snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin can/ /rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs kun sbyong ba/ /yang dag gsal ba'i 'bras bu mngon gyur shog /de ltar zab gsal rang bzhin gnyis med can/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid che/ /'khor ba'i chos kyis rab tu ma zin pa/ /chos dbyings dam pa 'jam dbyangs myur thob shog /gnas skabs kun tu tshe ring nad med cing / /log 'tsho spangs pa'i phun tshogs 'byor par ldan/ /tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba'i nor ldan pas/

/rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog /khyad par 'jam dbyangs mgon pos rjes bzung ba/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed grub chen ye shes zhabs/ /gang gis legs par bkral ba'i lam bzang 'di/ /ma nor phyogs mtha' kun tu rgyas byed shog /thugs rje che ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / /rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / /rdo rje chos skyongs rnams kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /bdag gi smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /zhes brjod cing 'og nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis bya/ dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi nyin mjug chog gi tshe bum pa gnyis khyams stengs su spyan drangs/ spyi btab kyi gtor ma phul grub rjes/ dpon slob rnams dkyil 'khor gyi mthar langs te/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtan bzhugs kyi bar 'dra zhing / skabs 'dir slob dpon gyis mchod bsngo gshin bsngo sogs skabs thob sbyar la rgyas bsdus gang rung nges par byed dgos par sems te/ sa skya'i gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du gnang bas so/ /rten yod pa rnams la brtan zhugs dkyus bzhin byas la/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes dang / rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams la/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs lan gsum gdangs dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ a kā ro sogs nas/ hūm̐ muḥzhes dang / mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs pa'i mthar/ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung la/ rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ a kā ro nas na twad kyi bar yang yang brjod la/ de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang po bshigs/ de nas g.yas bskor gyi mtshan ma rnams nas rdul tshon rang gi spyi bor bzhag gzhan 'dod pa yod na'ang sbyin/ rdo rje'i rtses phyogs bzhi nas ri mo 'then/ de nas sgrub grogs rnams kyis mtha' nas ku sha ras dkar sogs gtsang mas bsdus la rin po che'i snod ji ltar rigs par blug la dben par bzhag rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa'i phyag len yod na spyi 'gro ltar bya/

thig rjes rnams las bum gyi chus phyis/ de nas go bsgo ba/ bsngo ba smon lam rnams gong bzhin dang / dpon slob rnams kyis me tog gi char dbab/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas bla ma yi dam kyi bkra shis spyi dang khyad par/ dge legs kun 'byung rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ / bkra shis 'di mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa la gzhir byas/ tshigs rkang dgu mar bsgyur te 'phags lugs kyi bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho dang mthun par kho bos brtsams pa lags/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i dngos/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug grangs med 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas phan bde'i lam ston pa'i/ /'phags bod rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye rgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /theg chen longs spyod thabs shes mnyam sbyor sku/ /zag med bde ba che la rtag rol zhing / /spros bral 'gro don rgyun mi chad pa can/ /'gag med sku mnga' 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'khor lo'i bdag po'i bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye rgu kun dang bdag cag༞ /chos dang dge legs rgyas༞ /phung lnga gnas gyur dug lnga dbyings su dag /ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga'i 'gro ba 'dul/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin dang rgyal ba'i rgyal/ /rin chen 'chang dang 'khor 'das shes rab 'chang / /sngo dang dkar ser dmar ljang mdzes pa'i sku/ /bde gshegs yab lnga'i bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye rgu kun dang༞ /chos dang dge legs༞ /'byung ba rnam dag tshad med rang bzhin can/ /las bzhi'i 'gro 'dul thabs smon stobs ye shes/ /mthar phyin ring song la sogs sa yi dngos/ /spyan ma bdag ma gos dkar sgrol ma ste/ /'gro ba bud med 'dul phyir rig ma'i tshul/ /rgyal ba'i yum bzhi'i bkra shis dam pa des/

/skye rgu kun༞ /chos dang dge legs༞ /kun 'dzin 'chal tshul khro ba le los g.yeng / /shes rab 'chal dang yul drug dri ma sbyong / /rab dga' dri med la sogs sa yi dngos/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg dang chos khams kyis/ /zag med bde bas 'jam dpal rab mchod ma/ /lha mo'i tshogs kyis bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye rgu kun༞ /chos dang dge legs༞ /ma dad le lo brjed ngas rnam g.yeng dang / /phung nyon 'chi bdag lha bu'i bdud bzhi 'joms/ /'jig tshogs log lta mthar 'dzin brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /lta ngan drwa ba gcod mdzad khro bo'i dbang / /sgrib bral dad sogs rang bzhin rnam dag pa/ /sgo bsrung mchog gi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye rgu kun༞ /chos dang dge legs༞ /byang chub phyogs chos tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /rgyal ba'i bsti gnas rin chen gzhal med khang / /rgya chen 'od gsal bkod legs dbyibs mdzes pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i khang bzang mchog /bdud las rnam rgyal bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bcas/ /pho brang mchog gi bkra shis dam pa des/ /skye rgu kun dang bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /chos dang dge legs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /gzhan yang chos bsrung nor lha'i bkra shis gang shes/ phyogs kun tu me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ kun mkhyen smra ba'i seng ge go ram rje'i/ /zhal sgo las 'ong bstan bcos ngo mtshar can/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sgrub dkyil cha lag bcas/ /lhan cig sdebs pa'i nor bu'i phreng mdzes 'di/ /blo gsal rnams kyi mgul pa'i rgyan dam par/ /'gyur phyir 'khon rigs sa smyon bhu su ku/ /kun blos spel 'di'i dge ba dri med des/ /mkha' mnyam skye rgu kun dang lhan cig tu/ /bdag gir bcad las ma gyur 'gro ba kun/ /sgrib bral 'jam dbyangs go 'phang mngon gyur shog /bstan bcos 'di nyid 'dzin dang 'chad pa yi/ /'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen spel ba la/

/chos bdag zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi pas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil gnyis cha lag dang bcas te lhan cig tu bkod pa nor bu'i phreng mdzes blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni nyi shar chos sde ba rnams kyis gtso mdzad rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rtsa ba'i yig cha kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil gtor chog mchod 'phreng rnams dang / de dag tu mi gsal ba rnams ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi mchod 'phreng mchod sprin rgya mtsho/ 'jam rdor gyi bstod pa lam rim smon lam bcas dang / paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil lhan thabs/ sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi sgrub dkyil lhan cig tu bkod pa rnams nas legs bshad kyi cha blangs/ rang gi blo gros kyis kyang ji ltar 'os pa mtshams sbyar te adgi ra zhes pa chu pho spre'u'i lo phalgu na'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs dge bar rang gi bgrang gzhi bzhis lhag pa'i lnga phrag bzhi lon pa'i lo la dpal sa skya yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas kyi bla brang phun tshogs gling gi rang gi bsam gtan khang bu thos bsam nyi 'od snang ba dang / phun tshogs bde chen gnyis su nye bar gnas pa bsod nams 'od zer dang bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis yi ge'i 'du byed legs par bgyis te sdebs pa 'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na 'khor lo'i mgon po'i spyan sngar bshags shing / 'di'i dge bas rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
